![SentinelAI — Network Monitoring Platform](docs/assets/sentinelai-hero.png) # SentinelAI **Plataforma NMS full-stack** — discovery inteligente, topologia 2D/3D, hub **Zion**, monitoramento WMI/SNMP, alertas multicanal e inventário persistente. [![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-009688?style=for-the-badge&logo=fastapi&logoColor=white)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-20232A?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=61DAFB)](https://react.dev/) [![Celery](https://img.shields.io/badge/Celery-37814A?style=for-the-badge&logo=celery&logoColor=white)](https://docs.celeryq.dev/) [![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-316192?style=for-the-badge&logo=postgresql&logoColor=white)](https://www.postgresql.org/) [![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-2496ED?style=for-the-badge&logo=docker&logoColor=white)](https://www.docker.com/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Proprietary-red?style=for-the-badge)](#licença) [Quick Start](#-quick-start) · [Árvore do Conhecimento](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/index.html?tree=sentinelai) · [Arquitetura](#-arquitetura) · [Discovery](#-discovery-engine) · [API](#-api) · [Roadmap](#-roadmap)
--- ## O que é **SentinelAI** é uma plataforma de **monitoramento e inventário de infraestrutura de rede** pensada para equipes de engenharia e NOC. Combina: - Scan de sub-rede com **Nmap configurável** (perfis quick → aggressive) - Inventário **ativo + inativo** em sub-rede completa (`/24`) - **Mapa de topologia** interativo (React Flow) com vista **3D** - Hub operacional **Zion** — painéis por IP/métrica (CPU, RAM, disco, temperatura…) - Coleta **WMI** (Windows) + **SNMP**, alertas multicanal e relatórios - Paginação no dashboard (eventos 10/100 · dispositivos 10/2500) - Roadmap de **estabilização** (Fase 0+) além das fases enterprise 15–21 --- ## Quick Start ### Pré-requisitos - [Docker Desktop](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/) - Docker Compose v2 ### Subir em 3 comandos ```bash git clone https://github.com/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI.git cd SentinelAI cp .env.example .env && docker compose up --build -d ``` Desenvolvimento com hot-reload na API: ```bash docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build -d ``` > Em produção use `APP_ENV=production` com `SECRET_KEY` (≥32) e `ADMIN_PASSWORD` fortes. > Login com `admin123` força troca de senha no primeiro acesso. ### Acessar | Serviço | URL | Credenciais | |---------|-----|-------------| | **Frontend** | http://localhost:5173 | `admin` / `admin123` | | **API + Swagger** | http://localhost:8000/docs | JWT após login | | **PostgreSQL** | `localhost:5432` | ver `.env.example` | | **Redis** | `localhost:6379` | — | ### Primeiro scan 1. Login no dashboard 2. Informe a sub-rede (ex: `172.20.100.0/24`) 3. Escolha perfil **Padrão** (nmap + SNMP + inventário full subnet) 4. Clique **Escanear sub-rede** 5. Acompanhe **Total · Ativos · Inativos** em tempo real --- ## Árvore do Conhecimento Mapa **2D** e **Galaxy 3D** deste projeto (balões, modal de código) no hub central: **[SentinelAI na Tree of Knowledge](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/index.html?tree=sentinelai)** · [Hub completo](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/) --- ## Arquitetura ### Visão geral (C4 — Container) ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph Clients WEB[React SPA :5173] MOB[Expo Mobile] DESK[Electron Desktop] end subgraph Platform["SentinelAI Platform"] API[FastAPI :8000] FE[Vite Frontend] CW[Celery Worker] DW[Discovery Worker] BEAT[Celery Beat] end subgraph Data PG[(PostgreSQL 16)] RD[(Redis 7)] end subgraph External NM[Nmap / ICMP] SNMP[SNMP Agents] LDAP[LDAP / AD] end WEB --> FE --> API MOB --> API DESK --> FE API --> PG API --> RD CW --> PG DW --> PG DW --> RD BEAT --> RD DW --> NM DW --> SNMP API --> LDAP ``` ### Stack tecnológica | Camada | Tecnologias | |--------|-------------| | **Frontend** | React 18, Vite, TypeScript, React Flow, Lucide | | **Backend** | FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Pydantic v2, Alembic | | **Async** | Celery, Redis, filas `celery` + `discovery` | | **Discovery** | Nmap, python-nmap, SNMP (pysnmp), ICMP ping | | **Data** | PostgreSQL, JSONB (scan_options, extra_data) | | **Deploy** | Docker Compose, Helm, GitHub Actions CI | | **Observability** | Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry (opcional) | --- ## Discovery Engine ![Pipeline de Discovery](docs/assets/discovery-pipeline.png) ### Pipeline de scan ```mermaid flowchart LR A[POST /api/discovery] --> B{Job #1–100} B --> C[Celery discovery-worker] C --> D[Nmap / ICMP ping] D --> E[Hosts vivos] E --> F{Inventário} F --> G[SNMP + DNS enrich] F --> H[Marcar inativos] G --> I[(devices)] H --> I I --> J[Job completed] J --> K[UI: Total · Ativos · Inativos] ``` ### Perfis de scan | Perfil | Nmap | SNMP | Inventário /24 | |--------|------|------|----------------| | **Rápido** | Ping + top ports | Opcional | Não | | **Padrão** | SYN + scripts | Sim | Sim (ativos + inativos) | | **Profundo** | OS + UDP | Sim | Sim | | **Agressivo** | Timing T4/T5 | Sim | Sim | | **Personalizado** | UI avançada | Configurável | Configurável | ### Ciclo de jobs Os jobs de discovery usam IDs **#1 a #100**. Ao concluir o **#100**, o próximo scan reinicia em **#1** (histórico limpo, sequência resetada). --- ## Topologia 2D & 3D ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph Map2D["Mapa 2D — React Flow"] RF[Nodes + Edges] LLDP[LLDP/CDP auto] MAN[Links manuais] ELK[Auto-layout ELK] EXP[Export PNG/SVG/PDF/VSDX] end subgraph Map3D["Mapa 3D — Map3DView"] CSS[CSS 3D transforms] H[Altura por status] TRF[Tráfego animado] end TOPO[topology_service] --> Map2D TOPO --> Map3D SNMP2[SNMP counters] --> TRF ``` - **2D**: editor completo estilo *The Dude++* — drag-drop, camadas, grupos, colaboração WebSocket - **3D**: projeção com altura por status (`active` / `inactive`) e links com tráfego SNMP --- ## Monitoramento & Alertas ```mermaid flowchart LR DEV[Devices] --> MON[Monitors] MON --> PING[ICMP Ping] MON --> HTTP[HTTP/HTTPS] MON --> TCP[TCP Port] MON --> SNMP2[SNMP Poll] PING & HTTP & TCP & SNMP2 --> MET[(metrics)] MET --> ANO[Anomaly AI] MET --> ALT[Alert Engine] ALT --> EM[Email] ALT --> TG[Telegram] ALT --> SL[Slack] ALT --> DC[Discord] ALT --> TM[Teams] ALT --> WH[Webhook] ``` --- ## Estrutura do repositório ``` SentinelAI/ ├── backend/app/ │ ├── api/routes/ # REST + WebSocket │ ├── engines/ │ │ ├── discovery/ # Nmap, SNMP, scan_options, subnet_scanner │ │ ├── monitor/ # Ping, HTTP, TCP │ │ ├── alerts/ # Multicanal │ │ ├── ai/ # Anomalias, Copilot, vision │ │ └── reporting/ # PDF, Excel, VSDX │ ├── models/ # SQLAlchemy ORM │ ├── services/ # Regras de negócio │ └── workers/ # Celery tasks ├── frontend/src/ │ ├── pages/ # Dashboard, TopologyMap, Alerts… │ ├── components/ # Discovery, Map3D, charts │ └── api/ # Cliente HTTP tipado ├── docs/ │ ├── assets/ # Ilustrações README │ └── PHASE-*-ROADMAP.md ├── deploy/helm/ # Kubernetes ├── mobile/ # React Native (Expo) ├── docker-compose.yml └── .github/workflows/ci.yml ``` --- ## API Documentação interativa: **http://localhost:8000/docs** | Endpoint | Descrição | |----------|-----------| | `POST /api/auth/login` | JWT | | `GET/POST /api/discovery` | Jobs de scan | | `GET /api/discovery/scan-defaults` | Perfis e limites | | `GET/POST /api/devices` | Inventário | | `GET /api/topology/graph` | Grafo 2D/3D | | `GET /api/events` | Timeline | | `GET /health` | Health check | --- ## Desenvolvimento local ### Backend ```bash cd backend python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\activate # Windows pip install -r requirements.txt uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 ``` ### Frontend ```bash cd frontend npm install && npm run dev ``` ### Workers ```bash cd backend celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker -Q celery,discovery -l info ``` --- ## Configuração Copie `.env.example` → `.env`. Principais variáveis: ```env # Discovery SNMP_COMMUNITY=public DISCOVERY_DEFAULT_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24 DISCOVERY_JOBS_MAX_ID=100 # Alertas ALERT_CHANNELS_ENABLED=email,telegram,slack,webhook # LDAP (opcional) LDAP_ENABLED=false ``` --- ## Roadmap
Estabilização (Fase 0+) — operação confiável - Fase 0 ✅: baseline SNMP/WMI, inventário honesto, backup — [PHASE-0-BASELINE.md](docs/PHASE-0-BASELINE.md) - Fase 1–2: SSE Redis, health real, compose prod, cobertura SNMP, canais de alerta na UI - Cronograma completo: [CRONOGRAMA-ESTABILIZACAO.md](docs/CRONOGRAMA-ESTABILIZACAO.md)
Fases 0–10 — Core → Enterprise - Fase 0/1: MVP — API, JWT, ping, discovery ICMP - Fase 4: SNMP, inventário persistente, asset history - Fase 5: HTTP/TCP monitors, SLA, RBAC - Fase 6–8: Map Editor, colaboração WS, 3D, VSDX, tráfego animado - Fase 9–10: Sites, NetFlow, multi-tenant, plugins, SNMP traps → [PHASE-10-ROADMAP.md](docs/PHASE-10-ROADMAP.md)
Fases 11–21 — Plataforma → Scale / SaaS - Marketplace, HA, Electron, PWA, CI/CD - Prometheus/Grafana, Helm, OpenTelemetry - Vault, service mesh, SOC2, Copilot LLM - Stripe billing, self-healing, map vision, CDN - Fase 20–21: multi-moeda, marketplace ratings, WebXR, tax regional → [PHASE-19-ROADMAP.md](docs/PHASE-19-ROADMAP.md) · [PHASE-20-ROADMAP.md](docs/PHASE-20-ROADMAP.md) · [PHASE-21-ROADMAP.md](docs/PHASE-21-ROADMAP.md) · [MAP-EDITOR-ROADMAP.md](docs/MAP-EDITOR-ROADMAP.md)
--- ## Contribuindo 1. Fork → branch → PR 2. Siga o padrão existente (FastAPI services + React components) 3. Não commite `.env` — use `.env.example` 4. CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` --- ## Licença Projeto proprietário — **CanonEngineer / SentinelAI**. Uso interno ou conforme acordo de licença. ---
**SentinelAI** — *Observe. Discover. Map.* [GitHub](https://github.com/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI) · [Tree of Knowledge (SentinelAI)](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/index.html?tree=sentinelai)

nodes.title: .env.example
nodes.code:
# Database
POSTGRES_USER=sentinel
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=sentinel_secret
POSTGRES_DB=sentinelai
DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
DATABASE_URL_SYNC=postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai

# Redis
REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0

# API
SECRET_KEY=change-me-in-production-use-openssl-rand-hex-32
# development | production — em production, SECRET_KEY e ADMIN_PASSWORD fracos bloqueiam o arranque
APP_ENV=development
API_HOST=0.0.0.0
API_PORT=8000
CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:3000

# Auth (admin criado no 1º arranque; senha fraca força troca só no 1º login)
ADMIN_USERNAME=admin
ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123
# false = não sobrescrever a senha da BD com a do .env a cada restart
# true  = forçar sync (útil só no bootstrap / reset intencional)
ADMIN_SYNC_PASSWORD=false
# Pedir nova senha a cada N dias (0 = desativa rotação mensal)
PASSWORD_MAX_AGE_DAYS=30

# Email alerts (optional)
SMTP_HOST=
SMTP_PORT=587
SMTP_USER=
SMTP_PASSWORD=
SMTP_FROM=noreply@sentinelai.local
ALERT_EMAIL_TO=

# Alert channels (comma-separated: email,sms,push,telegram,discord,slack,teams,webhook)
ALERT_CHANNELS_ENABLED=email,webhook
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=
TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID=
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=
TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL=
GENERIC_WEBHOOK_URL=
TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=
TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=
TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER=
ALERT_SMS_TO=
EXPO_PUSH_ACCESS_TOKEN=
ALERT_ESCALATION_MINUTES=15
ALERT_SUPPRESS_REPEAT_MINUTES=30

# LDAP / Active Directory (optional)
LDAP_ENABLED=false
LDAP_SERVER=ldap://dc.example.com
LDAP_PORT=389
LDAP_USE_SSL=false
LDAP_BASE_DN=DC=example,DC=com
LDAP_BIND_DN=
LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD=
LDAP_USER_SEARCH_FILTER=(sAMAccountName={username})
LDAP_DEFAULT_ROLE=viewer

# Reports
REPORTS_OUTPUT_DIR=/app/reports

# Monitoring
PING_INTERVAL_SECONDS=60
PING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3
MONITOR_SSE_ENABLED=true

# SSH discovery (network/Linux)
SSH_ENABLED=false
SSH_DEFAULT_USERNAME=
SSH_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=
SSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=10

# Discovery & SNMP
SNMP_COMMUNITY=public
SNMP_PORT=161
SNMP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3
DISCOVERY_DEFAULT_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24
DISCOVERY_SCHEDULE_ENABLED=true

# WMI / inventário Windows (SEGREDO — só no .env local, nunca no Git)
# Configure com:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\set-wmi-credentials.ps1
# NÃO coloque senha real neste arquivo de exemplo.
WMI_ENABLED=false
WMI_USERNAME=
WMI_PASSWORD=
WMI_DOMAIN=
WMI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=8
SOFTWARE_INVENTORY_MAX_PACKAGES=100

# WinRM / protocol probes (Zion) — preferir as mesmas credenciais do WMI via script
WINRM_USERNAME=
WINRM_PASSWORD=
PROTOCOL_PROBE_ENABLED=true
PROTOCOL_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3
PROTOCOL_PROBE_ON_ENRICH=false

# NetFlow & SNMP Traps (desabilitados por padrão)
NETFLOW_ENABLED=false
NETFLOW_PORT=2055
SNMP_TRAP_ENABLED=false
SNMP_TRAP_PORT=162

# HA / Platform (Fase 11)
HA_MODE=false

# PostgreSQL streaming replica (dev)
# Uso: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.replica.yml up
#
# Primary: postgres :5432 | Replica read-only: postgres-replica :5433

services:
  postgres:
    command: >
      postgres
      -c wal_level=replica
      -c max_wal_senders=3
      -c max_replication_slots=3
      -c hot_standby=on
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./deploy/postgres/primary/init-replication.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-replication.sh:ro

      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}

      - ./deploy/postgres/replica/entrypoint.sh:/entrypoint.sh:ro
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "/entrypoint.sh"]

  api:

services:

    image: postgres:16-alpine

    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"

      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

  api:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    # Produção/estável por omissão (sem --reload). Dev: -f docker-compose.dev.yml
    command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 8
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - reports_data:/app/reports

      - "8000:8000"
      - "2055:2055/udp"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "python -c \"import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health')\""]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend

    env_file:

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master, develop]

jobs:
  backend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: backend
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: sentinel
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: sentinel_secret
          POSTGRES_DB: sentinelai
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U sentinel -d sentinelai"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 3s
          --health-retries 10
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@localhost:5432/sentinelai
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@localhost:5432/sentinelai
      REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
      SECRET_KEY: ci-secret-key-not-for-prod
      ADMIN_USERNAME: admin
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin123
      APP_ENV: development
      NETFLOW_ENABLED: "false"
      SNMP_TRAP_ENABLED: "false"
      COPILOT_LLM_ENABLED: "false"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
      - name: Ruff lint
        run: ruff check app tests --select E9,F63,F7,F82
      - name: Compile Python modules
        run: python -m compileall app
      - name: Alembic upgrade
        run: alembic upgrade head
      - name: Pytest
        run: pytest -q

  frontend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

  smoke-compose:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build images
        run: docker compose build api
      - name: Up core services
        run: docker compose up -d postgres redis api
      - name: Wait for health
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 40); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:8000/health >/dev/null; then
              echo "healthy"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 3
          done
          docker compose logs api --tail 80
          exit 1
      - name: Tear down
        if: always()
        run: docker compose down -v

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""SentinelAI lab agent — heartbeat + CPU/RAM/disk (+ services) push.

Usage:
  set SENTINEL_URL=http://localhost:8000
  set SENTINEL_AGENT_TOKEN=<token from Infraestrutura > Agentes>
  python agent/sentinel_lab_agent.py

Optional:
  SENTINEL_INTERVAL=30
  SENTINEL_HOSTNAME=lab-host-1
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import platform
import socket
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

VERSION = "0.1.0-lab"


def _env(name: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    return os.environ.get(name, default).strip()


def collect_metrics() -> dict:
    cpu_pct = None
    mem_pct = None
    disk_pct = None
    services: list[dict] = []

    try:
        import psutil  # type: ignore

        cpu_pct = round(float(psutil.cpu_percent(interval=0.4)), 2)
        mem_pct = round(float(psutil.virtual_memory().percent), 2)
        root = "C:\\" if os.name == "nt" else "/"
        disk_pct = round(float(psutil.disk_usage(root).percent), 2)
        for svc in ("sshd", "ssh", "wuauserv", "Spooler", "cron", "systemd-journald"):
            try:
                if hasattr(psutil, "win_service_get") and os.name == "nt":
                    try:
                        st = psutil.win_service_get(svc).as_dict().get("status", "unknown")
                        services.append({"name": svc, "status": str(st)})
                    except Exception:
                        continue
            except Exception:
                continue
    except ImportError:
        # Fallback sem psutil: métricas simuladas leves para lab
        load = os.getloadavg()[0] if hasattr(os, "getloadavg") else 1.0
        cpu_pct = round(min(load * 10, 99.0), 2)
        mem_pct = 42.0
        disk_pct = 55.0
        services = [{"name": "lab", "status": "running"}]

    return {
        "cpu_pct": cpu_pct,
        "mem_pct": mem_pct,
        "disk_pct": disk_pct,
        "hostname": _env("SENTINEL_HOSTNAME") or socket.gethostname(),
        "services": services,
        "version": VERSION,
        "ip_address": socket.gethostbyname(socket.gethostname()) if True else None,
    }


def post_json(url: str, token: str, body: dict) -> dict:
    data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=data,
        method="POST",
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "User-Agent": f"sentinel-lab-agent/{VERSION}",
        },
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))


def main() -> int:
    base = _env("SENTINEL_URL", "http://localhost:8000").rstrip("/")
    token = _env("SENTINEL_AGENT_TOKEN")
    interval = int(_env("SENTINEL_INTERVAL", "30") or "30")
    if not token:
        print("Defina SENTINEL_AGENT_TOKEN (token gerado ao criar o agent na UI).", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    print(f"SentinelAI lab agent {VERSION} → {base} interval={interval}s ({platform.system()})")
    while True:
        metrics = collect_metrics()
        try:
            post_json(f"{base}/api/agents/heartbeat", token, {"version": VERSION, "ip_address": metrics.get("ip_address")})
            row = post_json(f"{base}/api/agents/metrics", token, metrics)
            lm = row.get("last_metrics") or {}
            print(
                f"ok agent={row.get('id')} device={row.get('device_id')} "
                f"cpu={lm.get('cpu_pct')} mem={lm.get('mem_pct')} disk={lm.get('disk_pct')}"
            )
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            print(f"HTTP {exc.code}: {exc.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')}", file=sys.stderr)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        time.sleep(max(5, interval))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

target_metadata = Base.metadata


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    url = config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url")
    context.configure(url=url, target_metadata=target_metadata, literal_binds=True)
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    connectable = engine_from_config(
        config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {}),
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )
    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=target_metadata)
        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:

from collections.abc import Callable

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
from jose import JWTError, jwt
import bcrypt
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import settings
from app.database import get_db
from app.models import User, UserRole

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/api/auth/login")

ALGORITHM = "HS256"
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 60 * 24


def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    if not plain_password or not hashed_password:
        return False
    try:
        return bcrypt.checkpw(
            plain_password.encode("utf-8"),
            hashed_password.encode("utf-8"),
        )
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False


def get_password_hash(password: str) -> str:
    return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode("utf-8")


def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta | None = None) -> str:
    to_encode = data.copy()
    expire = datetime.now(UTC) + (expires_delta or timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES))
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    return jwt.encode(to_encode, settings.secret_key, algorithm=ALGORITHM)


async def get_current_user(
    token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
) -> User:
    credentials_exception = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Credenciais inválidas",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        username: str | None = payload.get("sub")
        if username is None:
            raise credentials_exception
    except JWTError as exc:
        raise credentials_exception from exc

    result = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.username == username))
    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if user is None or not user.is_active:
        raise credentials_exception
    return user


def require_role(*roles: UserRole) -> Callable:
    allowed = set(roles)

    async def checker(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:
        if user.role not in allowed:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="Permissão insuficiente")
        return user

    return checker


require_admin = require_role(UserRole.ADMIN)
require_operator = require_role(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.OPERATOR)
require_viewer = require_role(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.OPERATOR, UserRole.VIEWER)

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("", response_model=list[AgentResponse])
async def list_agents(_: User = Depends(require_operator)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.enterprise_service import list_agents

    with SyncSession() as session:
        return list_agents(session)


@router.post("", response_model=AgentCreateResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_agent(payload: AgentCreate, _: User = Depends(require_admin)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.enterprise_service import create_agent, list_agents

    with SyncSession() as session:
        agent, token = create_agent(session, payload.model_dump())
        session.commit()
        rows = list_agents(session)
    row = next(r for r in rows if r["id"] == agent.id)
    return {**row, "token": token}


@router.patch("/{agent_id}", response_model=AgentResponse)
async def update_agent(agent_id: int, payload: AgentUpdate, _: User = Depends(require_admin)):

    from app.services.enterprise_service import list_agents, update_agent

    with SyncSession() as session:
        agent = update_agent(session, agent_id, payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True))
        if not agent:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Agente não encontrado")
        session.commit()
        rows = list_agents(session)
    return next(r for r in rows if r["id"] == agent_id)

    from app.services.enterprise_service import delete_agent

        if not delete_agent(session, agent_id):

        session.commit()

    authorization: str = Header(..., alias="Authorization"),
):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.enterprise_service import agent_heartbeat, list_agents

    with SyncSession() as session:

        session.commit()
        rows = list_agents(session)
    return next(r for r in rows if r["id"] == agent.id)

        rows = list_agents(session)

import logging
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import settings
from app.database import get_db
from app.dependencies import create_access_token, get_current_user, get_password_hash, verify_password
from app.models import User, UserRole
from app.schemas.auth import ChangePasswordRequest, Token, UserResponse
from app.services.ldap_service import authenticate_ldap
from app.services.security_policy import password_change_required, validate_new_password

router = APIRouter()
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _default_role() -> UserRole:
    mapping = {
        "admin": UserRole.ADMIN,
        "operator": UserRole.OPERATOR,
        "viewer": UserRole.VIEWER,
    }
    return mapping.get(settings.ldap_default_role.lower(), UserRole.VIEWER)


async def _authenticate_user(db: AsyncSession, username: str, password: str) -> User | None:
    result = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.username == username))
    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()

    if settings.ldap_enabled and authenticate_ldap(username, password):
        if user is None:
            user = User(
                username=username,
                hashed_password=get_password_hash(password),
                role=_default_role(),
                is_ldap=True,
                must_change_password=False,
                password_changed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
            )
            db.add(user)
            await db.commit()
            await db.refresh(user)
        return user

    if user and verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
        return user
    return None


@router.post("/login", response_model=Token)
async def login(
    request: Request,
    form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    from app.services.rate_limit import check_rate_limit

    check_rate_limit(request, key="auth.login", limit=20, window_seconds=60)

    user = await _authenticate_user(db, form_data.username, form_data.password)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Usuário ou senha inválidos")

    changed = False
    # Contas legadas sem carimbo: inicia o ciclo mensal sem forçar troca agora.
    if not user.is_ldap and user.password_changed_at is None and not user.must_change_password:
        user.password_changed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        changed = True

    must_change = password_change_required(user, max_age_days=settings.password_max_age_days)
    if must_change and not user.must_change_password and not user.is_ldap:
        user.must_change_password = True
        changed = True

    if changed:
        await db.commit()

    token = create_access_token(data={"sub": user.username, "role": user.role.value}, expires_delta=timedelta(hours=24))

    try:
        from app.db_sync import SyncSession
        from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

        with SyncSession() as session:
            log_audit(
                session,
                action="auth.login",
                resource_type="user",
                resource_id=user.username,
                user_id=user.id,
                username=user.username,
                org_id=user.org_id,
            )
            session.commit()
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Failed to write login audit log")

    return Token(access_token=token, must_change_password=must_change)


@router.post("/change-password", response_model=UserResponse)
async def change_password(
    body: ChangePasswordRequest,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    if current_user.is_ldap:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Contas LDAP devem alterar a senha no diretório")

    if not verify_password(body.current_password, current_user.hashed_password):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Senha atual incorreta")

    try:
        validate_new_password(body.new_password, username=current_user.username)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    if verify_password(body.new_password, current_user.hashed_password):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="A nova senha deve ser diferente da atual")

    current_user.hashed_password = get_password_hash(body.new_password)
    current_user.must_change_password = False
    current_user.password_changed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(current_user)

    try:
        from app.db_sync import SyncSession
        from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

        with SyncSession() as session:
            log_audit(
                session,
                action="auth.change_password",
                resource_type="user",
                resource_id=current_user.username,
                user_id=current_user.id,
                username=current_user.username,
                org_id=current_user.org_id,
            )
            session.commit()
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Failed to write change-password audit log")

    return current_user


@router.get("/me", response_model=UserResponse)
async def me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):

        role=current_user.role,
        is_ldap=current_user.is_ldap,
        is_active=current_user.is_active,
        must_change_password=must,
        password_changed_at=current_user.password_changed_at,
        password_max_age_days=settings.password_max_age_days,
    )

    return request.client.host if request.client else None

import time

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import settings
from app.database import get_db
from app.dependencies import require_operator, require_viewer
from app.engines.discovery.dns_resolver import iter_host_addresses, validate_subnet
from app.models import DiscoveryJob, DiscoveryJobStatus, User
from app.engines.discovery.scan_options import list_scan_defaults, resolve_scan_options
from app.schemas.discovery import (
    DiscoveryJobCreate,
    DiscoveryJobResponse,
    ScanDefaultsResponse,
)
from app.services.discovery_service import (
    cycle_discovery_job_ids_if_needed,
    fail_stuck_pending_discovery_jobs,
    fail_orphaned_discovery_jobs,
    fail_stale_discovery_jobs,
    has_active_discovery_job,
    prune_discovery_jobs,
    reconcile_cancelled_discovery_jobs,
    stop_discovery_job,
)
from app.workers.discovery_tasks import run_discovery_job

router = APIRouter()

MAX_JOBS = settings.discovery_jobs_max_history
_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30.0
_last_reconcile_monotonic = 0.0


def _maybe_reconcile_discovery_jobs() -> None:
    """Reconcilia jobs órfãos/stale no máximo a cada 30s (evita esgotar pool no polling)."""
    global _last_reconcile_monotonic
    now = time.monotonic()
    if now - _last_reconcile_monotonic < _RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
        return
    _last_reconcile_monotonic = now

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        stale = fail_stale_discovery_jobs(session)
        stuck = fail_stuck_pending_discovery_jobs(session)
        orphaned = fail_orphaned_discovery_jobs(session)
        reconciled = reconcile_cancelled_discovery_jobs(session)
        if stale or stuck or orphaned or reconciled:
            session.commit()


@router.get("", response_model=list[DiscoveryJobResponse])
async def list_discovery_jobs(
    limit: int = MAX_JOBS,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    cap = min(max(limit, 1), MAX_JOBS)

    _maybe_reconcile_discovery_jobs()

    result = await db.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).order_by(DiscoveryJob.created_at.desc()).limit(cap)
    )
    return result.scalars().all()


@router.get("/scan-defaults", response_model=ScanDefaultsResponse)
async def get_scan_defaults(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    return list_scan_defaults()


def _build_scan_options_payload(payload: DiscoveryJobCreate) -> dict:
    if payload.scan_options:
        opts = payload.scan_options.model_dump(exclude_none=True)
    else:
        opts = {"profile": "standard"}

    if payload.scan_options is None or payload.scan_options.use_snmp is None:
        opts["use_snmp"] = payload.use_snmp
    community = payload.snmp_community or opts.get("snmp_community")
    if community:
        opts["snmp_community"] = community
    communities = payload.snmp_communities or opts.get("snmp_communities")
    if communities:
        opts["snmp_communities"] = [str(item).strip() for item in communities if str(item).strip()]
    return opts


@router.post("", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED)
async def start_discovery(
    payload: DiscoveryJobCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    try:
        validate_subnet(payload.subnet)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        if has_active_discovery_job(session):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail="Já existe um scan em andamento. Cancele-o antes de iniciar outro.",
            )
        cycle_discovery_job_ids_if_needed(session)
        session.commit()

    scan_opts_dict = _build_scan_options_payload(payload)
    resolved = resolve_scan_options(
        scan_opts_dict,
        snmp_community_fallback=payload.snmp_community or settings.snmp_community,
    )

    job = DiscoveryJob(
        subnet=payload.subnet,
        use_snmp=resolved.use_snmp,
        snmp_community=resolved.snmp_community,
        snmp_communities=resolved.snmp_communities,
        scan_options=scan_opts_dict,
        status=DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING,
        progress_percent=0,
        progress_label=f"Aguardando worker · perfil {resolved.label}",
        hosts_processed=0,
        devices_found=0,
        devices_inactive=0,
        total_hosts=len(iter_host_addresses(payload.subnet)),
    )
    db.add(job)
    await db.flush()

    async_result = run_discovery_job.apply_async(args=[job.id], queue="discovery", priority=9)
    job.celery_task_id = async_result.id
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(job)

    with SyncSession() as session:
        prune_discovery_jobs(session, keep=MAX_JOBS)
        session.commit()

    return job


@router.post("/{job_id}/stop", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse)
async def stop_discovery(
    job_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    job = await db.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")

    if job.status in (DiscoveryJobStatus.COMPLETED, DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED):
        return job

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        sync_job = session.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
        if not sync_job:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")
        stop_discovery_job(session, sync_job)
        session.commit()
        session.refresh(sync_job)
        response = DiscoveryJobResponse.model_validate(sync_job)

    return response


@router.get("/{job_id}", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse)
async def get_discovery_job(
    job_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    job = await db.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")
    return job

    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    result = await db.execute(select(ReportJob).order_by(ReportJob.created_at.desc()).limit(limit))
    return result.scalars().all()


@router.post("/jobs", response_model=ReportJobResponse, status_code=202)
async def create_report_job(
    payload: ReportJobCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    if payload.report_type not in ("devices", "events", "summary", "sla"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="report_type inválido")
    if payload.format not in ("xlsx", "pdf"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="format inválido")
    if payload.report_type in ("summary", "sla") and payload.format != "pdf":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="summary/sla exigem format=pdf")
    if payload.report_type not in ("summary", "sla") and payload.format == "pdf":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="PDF disponível apenas para summary/sla")
    if payload.report_type == "sla" and not payload.site_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="site_id obrigatório para relatório SLA")

    params = {"site_id": payload.site_id} if payload.site_id else None
    job = ReportJob(report_type=payload.report_type, format=payload.format, params=params)
    db.add(job)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(job)
    days = payload.days if payload.report_type != "sla" else (payload.days or 30)
    generate_report_task.delay(job.id, days)
    return job


@router.get("/jobs/{job_id}/download")
async def download_report(job_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    job = await db.get(ReportJob, job_id)
    if not job or not job.file_path:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Relatório não disponível")
    import os
    if not os.path.isfile(job.file_path):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Arquivo não encontrado")
    media = "application/pdf" if job.format == "pdf" else "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
    filename = os.path.basename(job.file_path)
    return FileResponse(job.file_path, media_type=media, filename=filename)

"""SSE de monitoramento — Redis pub/sub + ticket de curta duração."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import time
from datetime import timedelta

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, Request
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
from jose import JWTError, jwt

from app.config import settings
from app.dependencies import ALGORITHM, create_access_token, get_current_user
from app.models import User
from app.services.realtime_events import event_bus

router = APIRouter()

# Evita conexões eternas a segurar o shutdown do uvicorn
SSE_MAX_SECONDS = 300
SSE_TICKET_SECONDS = 60


def _username_from_sse_credential(token: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        purpose = payload.get("purpose")
        # Aceita ticket SSE (purpose=sse) ou JWT de sessão legado (sem purpose)
        if purpose is not None and purpose != "sse":
            return None
        sub = payload.get("sub")
        return sub if isinstance(sub, str) and sub else None
    except JWTError:
        return None


@router.post("/ticket")
async def create_sse_ticket(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """Ticket JWT curto para EventSource (evita access token longo na query string)."""
    from app.config import settings
    from app.services.security_policy import password_change_required

    if password_change_required(current_user, max_age_days=settings.password_max_age_days):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="É necessário alterar a senha antes de continuar")
    ticket = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": current_user.username, "purpose": "sse"},
        expires_delta=timedelta(seconds=SSE_TICKET_SECONDS),
    )
    return {"ticket": ticket, "expires_in": SSE_TICKET_SECONDS}


@router.get("/monitoring")
async def monitoring_stream(
    request: Request,
    ticket: str | None = Query(None),
    token: str | None = Query(None, deprecated=True),
):
    """SSE de eventos de monitoramento, discovery e status."""
    credential = ticket or token
    if not credential:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ticket ou token obrigatório")
    if not _username_from_sse_credential(credential):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Credencial SSE inválida")

    async def generate():
        queue = await event_bus.subscribe()
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            for item in event_bus.recent(5):
                if await request.is_disconnected():
                    break
                yield f"data: {json.dumps(item)}\n\n"
            while True:
                if await request.is_disconnected():
                    break
                if time.monotonic() - started > SSE_MAX_SECONDS:
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'reconnect', 'payload': {}, 'created_at': ''})}\n\n"
                    break
                try:
                    event = await asyncio.wait_for(queue.get(), timeout=10.0)
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps(event.to_dict())}\n\n"
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'heartbeat', 'payload': {}, 'created_at': ''})}\n\n"
                    await asyncio.sleep(0)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        finally:
            event_bus.unsubscribe(queue)

    return StreamingResponse(
        generate(),
        media_type="text/event-stream",
        headers={
            "Cache-Control": "no-cache",
            "Connection": "keep-alive",
            "X-Accel-Buffering": "no",
        },
    )

    existing = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.username == payload.username))
    if existing.scalar_one_or_none():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Usuário já existe")

        hashed_password=get_password_hash(payload.password),
        role=payload.role,

    db.add(user)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(user)
    return user

    user_id: int,
    payload: UserUpdate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    current: User = Depends(require_admin),
):
    user = await db.get(User, user_id)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Usuário não encontrado")
    if user.id == current.id and payload.is_active is False:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Não é possível desativar a si mesmo")
    if payload.role is not None:
        user.role = payload.role
    if payload.is_active is not None:
        user.is_active = payload.is_active
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(user)
    return user

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from statistics import mean, stdev

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import AnomalyRecord, Device, Event, EventSeverity, Metric


def detect_latency_anomalies(session: Session, lookback_hours: int = 168, z_threshold: float = 2.0) -> list[AnomalyRecord]:
    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(hours=lookback_hours)
    devices = session.execute(select(Device)).scalars().all()
    detected: list[AnomalyRecord] = []

    for device in devices:
        metrics = (
            session.execute(
                select(Metric)
                .where(
                    Metric.device_id == device.id,
                    Metric.metric_name == "latency_ms",
                    Metric.recorded_at >= cutoff,
                )
                .order_by(Metric.recorded_at.desc())
                .limit(200)
            )
            .scalars()
            .all()
        )
        if len(metrics) < 10:
            continue

        values = [m.value for m in metrics[1:]]
        latest = metrics[0].value
        avg = mean(values)
        try:
            std = stdev(values)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if std == 0:
            continue

        if latest > avg + z_threshold * std:
            existing = session.execute(
                select(AnomalyRecord).where(
                    AnomalyRecord.device_id == device.id,
                    AnomalyRecord.metric_name == "latency_ms",
                    AnomalyRecord.is_resolved.is_(False),
                )
            ).scalar_one_or_none()
            if existing:
                continue

            msg = (
                f"Latência anômala em {device.ip_address}: {latest:.1f}ms "
                f"(baseline {avg:.1f}±{std:.1f}ms)"
            )
            record = AnomalyRecord(
                device_id=device.id,
                metric_name="latency_ms",
                expected_value=avg,
                actual_value=latest,
                severity=EventSeverity.WARNING if latest < avg + 3 * std else EventSeverity.CRITICAL,
                message=msg,
            )
            session.add(record)
            session.add(
                Event(
                    device_id=device.id,
                    event_type="anomaly_detected",
                    message=msg,
                    severity=record.severity,
                )
            )
            detected.append(record)

    session.flush()
    return detected

Fonte canónica espelhada de docs/feature-inventory.json + módulos da UI.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data"
_INVENTORY_CANDIDATES = [
    _DATA_DIR / "feature-inventory.json",
    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "docs" / "feature-inventory.json",
    Path("/docs/feature-inventory.json"),
]

MODULES_GUIDE = """
# SentinelAI — Guia de módulos (chatbot)

## O que é
SentinelAI é uma plataforma NMS (Network Management System) com map editor estilo The Dude,
discovery multi-protocolo, alertas multicanal, Zion (visão Zabbix-like), NOC Copilot e chatbot IA.

Login: use as credenciais configuradas no ambiente (`.env` / Usuários). Nunca compartilhe senhas em chat.
API: FastAPI em /api (docs em /docs). Frontend React em :5173.
IA: DeepSeek / Ollama / OpenAI — ver docs/LLM-DEEPSEEK-OLLAMA.md.

## Menu principal
- **Dashboard** — visão geral, widgets personalizáveis
- **Mapa de Rede** — editor 2D/3D (React Flow), drag-drop, undo/redo, camadas, export PNG/SVG/PDF
- **Scanner** — scan de portas TCP estilo nmap lite
- **Relatórios & IA** — anomalias, PDF/XLSX, resumo executivo, SOC2
- **NOC Copilot** — assistente operacional com LLM (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Ollama) + regras locais
- **Chatbot** — ajuda sobre o produto SentinelAI (esta base de conhecimento)
- **Alertas** — e-mail, SMS (Twilio), Telegram/Slack/Discord/Teams, push mobile
- **Infraestrutura** — sites, agentes remotos, NetFlow
- **Plataforma** — SaaS multi-tenant, billing, edge, CDN
- **Usuários** — RBAC (admin/operator/viewer), LDAP opcional
- **Zion** — hub estilo Zabbix: discovery, inventário, templates, monitoramento, mapa, eventos, protocolos

## Discovery / inventário
Protocolos: ICMP, SNMP (LLDP/CDP, mem/disco/temp), SSH, WMI/WinRM, software inventory (hrSW + WMI).
Probes extras: Modbus, MQTT, IPMI, Telnet, NTP.
Jobs Celery: poll SNMP, discovery, protocol probes.

## Monitoramento
SSE `/api/stream/monitoring`, métricas históricas, status active/inactive/unknown/retired.
Hardware: GET `/api/devices/{id}/hardware`. Software: `/api/devices/{id}/software`.

## Segurança e plataforma
Vault/secrets, audit logs, federação, zero-trust (config), remediação autónoma, visão de mapa (vision).

## IA
- NOC Copilot: `POST /api/copilot/chat` — contexto live de devices/alertas/anomalias
- Chatbot produto: `POST /api/chatbot/chat` — responde sobre funcionalidades e como usar
- Provider recomendado: DeepSeek (`COPILOT_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek`) — https://github.com/deepseek-ai
- Alternativas: OpenAI API ou Ollama local com modelo DeepSeek

## Credenciais LLM (.env)
COPILOT_LLM_ENABLED=true
COPILOT_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek
COPILOT_LLM_API_KEY=sk-...
COPILOT_LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com
COPILOT_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-chat
# Local Ollama:
# COPILOT_LLM_PROVIDER=ollama
# COPILOT_LLM_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1
# COPILOT_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-r1:latest
""".strip()


def _load_inventory_text() -> str:
    for path in _INVENTORY_CANDIDATES:
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            lines = [f"Inventário v{data.get('version', '?')} — {data.get('project', 'SentinelAI')}"]
            for section in (data.get("sections") or {}).values():
                title = section.get("title", "Secção")
                lines.append(f"\n## {title}")
                for item in section.get("items") or []:
                    status = item.get("status", "?")
                    label = item.get("label", item.get("id", ""))
                    notes = item.get("notes") or ""
                    lines.append(f"- [{status}] {label}" + (f" — {notes}" if notes else ""))
            return "\n".join(lines)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("Falha ao ler inventário %s: %s", path, exc)
    return "(inventário de features não encontrado no filesystem — use o guia de módulos)"


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def build_knowledge_corpus() -> str:
    inventory = _load_inventory_text()
    return f"{MODULES_GUIDE}\n\n# Inventário de funcionalidades\n{inventory}"


def search_knowledge(query: str, *, limit: int = 12) -> list[str]:
    """Recuperação simples por palavras-chave (RAG-lite)."""
    corpus = build_knowledge_corpus()
    q_words = {w.lower() for w in query.split() if len(w) > 2}
    scored: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    for block in corpus.split("\n"):
        line = block.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        lower = line.lower()
        score = sum(1 for w in q_words if w in lower)
        if score:
            scored.append((score, line))
    scored.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], -len(x[1])))
    seen: set[str] = set()
    out: list[str] = []
    for _, line in scored:
        if line in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(line)
        out.append(line)
        if len(out) >= limit:
            break
    return out

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Alert, AlertStatus, AnomalyRecord, Device, DeviceStatus, Event, EventSeverity, Metric


def generate_executive_summary(session: Session, days: int = 7) -> str:
    since = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=days)

    total_devices = session.execute(select(func.count(Device.id))).scalar() or 0
    active = session.execute(
        select(func.count(Device.id)).where(Device.status == DeviceStatus.ACTIVE)
    ).scalar() or 0
    inactive = session.execute(
        select(func.count(Device.id)).where(Device.status == DeviceStatus.INACTIVE)
    ).scalar() or 0

    events = session.execute(
        select(func.count(Event.id)).where(Event.created_at >= since)
    ).scalar() or 0
    critical = session.execute(
        select(func.count(Event.id)).where(Event.created_at >= since, Event.severity == EventSeverity.CRITICAL)
    ).scalar() or 0

    alerts_sent = session.execute(
        select(func.count(Alert.id)).where(Alert.status == AlertStatus.SENT, Alert.created_at >= since)
    ).scalar() or 0

    anomalies = session.execute(
        select(func.count(AnomalyRecord.id)).where(
            AnomalyRecord.detected_at >= since, AnomalyRecord.is_resolved.is_(False)
        )
    ).scalar() or 0

    avg_latency = session.execute(
        select(func.avg(Metric.value)).where(
            Metric.metric_name == "latency_ms", Metric.recorded_at >= since
        )
    ).scalar()

    uptime_pct = (active / total_devices * 100) if total_devices else 0
    latency_text = f"{avg_latency:.1f} ms" if avg_latency else "N/A"

    return f"""Relatório Executivo SentinelAI — últimos {days} dias

Infraestrutura: {total_devices} dispositivos monitorados ({active} online, {inactive} offline).
Disponibilidade estimada: {uptime_pct:.1f}%.
Latência média: {latency_text}.

Eventos registrados: {events} ({critical} críticos).
Alertas enviados: {alerts_sent}.
Anomalias ativas: {anomalies}.

import httpx

from app.config import settings
from app.engines.alerts.email import send_email_alert
from app.engines.alerts.push import send_push_alert

@dataclass
class AlertPayload:
    subject: str
    body: str
    severity: str
    event_type: str


async def send_telegram(payload: AlertPayload) -> bool:
    if not settings.telegram_bot_token or not settings.telegram_chat_id:
        return False
    text = f"🚨 *{payload.subject}*\n\n{payload.body}\n\n_Severidade: {payload.severity}_"
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{settings.telegram_bot_token}/sendMessage"
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
            r = await client.post(url, json={"chat_id": settings.telegram_chat_id, "text": text, "parse_mode": "Markdown"})
            return r.status_code == 200
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("Telegram alert failed: %s", exc)
        return False


async def send_discord(payload: AlertPayload) -> bool:
    if not settings.discord_webhook_url:
        return False
    color = {"critical": 0xDC2626, "warning": 0xD97706, "info": 0x2563EB}.get(payload.severity, 0x64748B)
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
            r = await client.post(
                settings.discord_webhook_url,
                json={
                    "embeds": [{
                        "title": payload.subject,
                        "description": payload.body,
                        "color": color,
                        "footer": {"text": f"SentinelAI · {payload.event_type}"},
                    }]
                },
            )
            return r.status_code in (200, 204)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("Discord alert failed: %s", exc)
        return False


async def send_slack(payload: AlertPayload) -> bool:
    if not settings.slack_webhook_url:
        return False
    emoji = {"critical": "🔴", "warning": "🟡", "info": "🟢"}.get(payload.severity, "ℹ️")
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
            r = await client.post(
                settings.slack_webhook_url,
                json={"text": f"{emoji} *{payload.subject}*\n{payload.body}"},
            )
            return r.status_code == 200
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("Slack alert failed: %s", exc)
        return False


async def send_teams(payload: AlertPayload) -> bool:
    if not settings.teams_webhook_url:
        return False
    theme = {"critical": "attention", "warning": "warning", "info": "good"}.get(payload.severity, "default")
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
            r = await client.post(
                settings.teams_webhook_url,
                json={
                    "@type": "MessageCard",
                    "@context": "http://schema.org/extensions",
                    "themeColor": theme,
                    "summary": payload.subject,
                    "sections": [{"activityTitle": payload.subject, "text": payload.body}],
                },
            )
            return r.status_code == 200
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("Teams alert failed: %s", exc)
        return False


async def send_webhook(payload: AlertPayload) -> bool:
    if not settings.generic_webhook_url:
        return False
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
            r = await client.post(
                settings.generic_webhook_url,
                json={
                    "source": "sentinelai",
                    "subject": payload.subject,
                    "body": payload.body,
                    "severity": payload.severity,
                    "event_type": payload.event_type,
                },
            )
            return r.status_code in (200, 201, 204)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("Webhook alert failed: %s", exc)
        return False


CHANNEL_SENDERS = {
    "email": lambda p: send_email_alert(p.subject, p.body),
    "sms": lambda p: send_sms_alert(p.subject, p.body),
    "push": lambda p: send_push_alert(p.subject, p.body),
    "telegram": send_telegram,
    "discord": send_discord,
    "slack": send_slack,
    "teams": send_teams,
    "webhook": send_webhook,
}


async def dispatch_to_channel(channel: str, payload: AlertPayload) -> bool:
    sender = CHANNEL_SENDERS.get(channel)
    if not sender:
        return False
    try:
        return await sender(payload)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("Channel %s failed: %s", channel, exc)
        return False


async def dispatch_to_config(
    row: AlertChannelConfig,
    payload: AlertPayload,
    *,
    destination: str | None = None,
) -> bool:
    from app.services.alert_channel_service import send_via_channel_config

    try:
        ok, _ = await send_via_channel_config(
            row,
            subject=payload.subject,
            body=payload.body,
            destination=destination,
        )
        return ok
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("Configured channel %s failed: %s", row.id, exc)
        return False

from email.message import EmailMessage

from app.config import settings

async def send_email_alert(subject: str, body: str) -> bool:
    if not settings.smtp_host or not settings.alert_email_to:
        logger.info("Email não configurado. Alerta: %s - %s", subject, body)
        return False

    message = EmailMessage()
    message["From"] = settings.smtp_from
    message["To"] = settings.alert_email_to
    message["Subject"] = subject
    message.set_content(body)

    try:
        await aiosmtplib.send(
            message,
            hostname=settings.smtp_host,
            port=settings.smtp_port,
            username=settings.smtp_user or None,
            password=settings.smtp_password or None,
            start_tls=True,
        )
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("Falha ao enviar email: %s", exc)
        return False

        settings.twilio_account_sid
        and settings.twilio_auth_token

async def send_sms_alert(subject: str, body: str) -> bool:

    text = f"{subject}\n\n{body}"[:1600]

        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:

                data={
                    "From": settings.twilio_from_number,

            logger.error("Twilio SMS failed (%s): %s", response.status_code, response.text[:500])
            return False
    except Exception as exc:

import hashlib
import logging

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def backup_device_config(host: str, username: str | None = None, password: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:
    username = username or settings.ssh_default_username
    password = password or settings.ssh_default_password

    if not username or not password:
        raise ValueError("Credenciais SSH não configuradas (SSH_DEFAULT_USERNAME/PASSWORD)")

    try:
        import paramiko
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("paramiko não instalado") from exc

    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
    try:
        client.connect(host, username=username, password=password, timeout=15, look_for_keys=False, allow_agent=False)
        stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("show running-config", timeout=30)
        content = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        err = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        if not content.strip():
            stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null; uname -a", timeout=15)
            content = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        if not content.strip() and err:
            raise RuntimeError(err.strip() or "Comando SSH sem saída")
        content_hash = hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()
        return content, content_hash
    finally:
        client.close()

"""Scan de rede via nmap (descoberta + portas/serviços/OS)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from app.config import settings
from app.engines.discovery.discovery_progress import nmap_percent, nmap_range_percent
from app.engines.discovery.dns_resolver import iter_host_addresses
from app.engines.discovery.scan_options import ResolvedScanOptions, resolve_scan_options

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]
CancelCallback = Callable[[], bool]


class ScanCancelledError(Exception):
    """Scan interrompido pelo usuário."""


class ScanTimeoutError(Exception):
    """Scan excedeu tempo máximo permitido."""


@dataclass
class NmapHost:
    ip_address: str
    hostname: str | None = None
    mac_address: str | None = None
    vendor: str | None = None
    os_name: str | None = None
    open_ports: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class NmapScanResult:
    alive_hosts: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    hosts: dict[str, NmapHost] = field(default_factory=dict)
    total_hosts: int = 0
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def nmap_available() -> bool:
    return shutil.which(settings.nmap_path) is not None


def _format_elapsed(seconds: float) -> str:
    total = int(seconds)
    if total < 60:
        return f"{total}s"
    minutes, secs = divmod(total, 60)
    if minutes < 60:
        return f"{minutes}m {secs}s"
    hours, minutes = divmod(minutes, 60)
    return f"{hours}h {minutes}m"


def _common_nmap_args() -> list[str]:
    return [
        "-n",
        "--host-timeout",
        settings.nmap_host_timeout,
        "--max-retries",
        str(settings.nmap_max_retries),
    ]


def _parse_nmap_xml(xml_text: str) -> dict[str, NmapHost]:
    hosts: dict[str, NmapHost] = {}
    if not xml_text.strip():
        return hosts

    root = ET.fromstring(xml_text)
    for host_el in root.findall("host"):
        status = host_el.find("status")
        if status is not None and status.get("state") != "up":
            continue

        ip: str | None = None
        mac: str | None = None
        vendor: str | None = None
        for addr in host_el.findall("address"):
            if addr.get("addrtype") == "ipv4":
                ip = addr.get("addr")
            elif addr.get("addrtype") == "mac":
                mac = addr.get("addr")
                vendor = addr.get("vendor")

        if not ip:
            continue

        hostname: str | None = None
        hostnames = host_el.find("hostnames")
        if hostnames is not None:
            for hn in hostnames.findall("hostname"):
                name = hn.get("name")
                if name:
                    hostname = name
                    break

        os_name: str | None = None
        os_el = host_el.find("os")
        if os_el is not None:
            matches = os_el.findall("osmatch")
            if matches:
                os_name = matches[0].get("name")

        open_ports: list[dict] = []
        ports_el = host_el.find("ports")
        if ports_el is not None:
            for port_el in ports_el.findall("port"):
                state_el = port_el.find("state")
                if state_el is None or state_el.get("state") != "open":
                    continue
                service_el = port_el.find("service")
                open_ports.append(
                    {
                        "port": int(port_el.get("portid", 0)),
                        "protocol": port_el.get("protocol", "tcp"),
                        "service": service_el.get("name") if service_el is not None else None,
                        "product": service_el.get("product") if service_el is not None else None,
                        "version": service_el.get("version") if service_el is not None else None,
                    }
                )

        hosts[ip] = NmapHost(
            ip_address=ip,
            hostname=hostname,
            mac_address=mac,
            vendor=vendor,
            os_name=os_name,
            open_ports=open_ports,
        )

    return hosts


def _merge_hosts(result: NmapScanResult, parsed: dict[str, NmapHost]) -> None:
    for ip, host in parsed.items():
        base = result.hosts.get(ip)
        if base:
            base.hostname = host.hostname or base.hostname
            base.mac_address = host.mac_address or base.mac_address
            base.vendor = host.vendor or base.vendor
            base.os_name = host.os_name or base.os_name
            base.open_ports = host.open_ports or base.open_ports
        else:
            result.hosts[ip] = host
            if ip not in result.alive_hosts:
                result.alive_hosts.append(ip)


def _terminate_process(proc: subprocess.Popen[bytes]) -> None:
    proc.terminate()
    try:
        proc.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        proc.kill()
        proc.wait(timeout=5)


def _run_nmap(
    args: list[str],
    *,
    on_progress: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    should_cancel: CancelCallback | None = None,
    progress_start: int = 0,
    progress_end: int = 100,
    progress_label: str = "nmap",
    timeout_seconds: int | None = None,
) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    cmd = [settings.nmap_path, *args]
    errors: list[str] = []
    xml_chunks: list[str] = []

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".xml", delete=False) as tmp:
        xml_path = tmp.name

    cmd.extend(["-oX", xml_path])

    try:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )

        started = time.monotonic()
        last_heartbeat = 0.0
        span = max(progress_end - progress_start, 1)

        while proc.poll() is None:
            if should_cancel and should_cancel():
                _terminate_process(proc)
                raise ScanCancelledError("Scan cancelado pelo usuário")

            now = time.monotonic()
            elapsed = now - started

            if timeout_seconds is not None and elapsed > timeout_seconds:
                _terminate_process(proc)
                raise ScanTimeoutError(
                    f"{progress_label} excedeu {timeout_seconds}s (limite de tempo)"
                )

            heartbeat = settings.nmap_progress_heartbeat_seconds
            if on_progress and (now - last_heartbeat) >= heartbeat:
                last_heartbeat = now
                if timeout_seconds:
                    ratio = min(0.95, elapsed / timeout_seconds)
                else:
                    ratio = min(0.95, elapsed / 300)
                pct = progress_start + int(span * ratio)
                on_progress(
                    pct,
                    f"{progress_label} · {_format_elapsed(elapsed)}",
                )

from __future__ import annotations

ScanProfile = Literal["quick", "standard", "deep", "aggressive", "custom"]

@dataclass

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> ScanOptions:
        if not data:
            return cls()
        known = {f.name for f in cls.__dataclass_fields__.values()}  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        return cls(**{k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in known})

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        from dataclasses import asdict

        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ResolvedScanOptions:
    profile: ScanProfile
    discover_only: bool

    service_detection: bool

PROFILE_META: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {
    "quick": {
        "label": "Rápido",
        "description": "Descoberta de hosts (-sn) e inventário leve. Sem scan de portas.",
    },
    "standard": {
        "label": "Padrão",
        "description": "Descoberta + portas SYN, serviços/OS em redes pequenas, SNMP completo.",
    },

    },

        "label": "Agressivo",

    },

        "label": "Personalizado",

    },

def _profile_defaults(profile: ScanProfile) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if profile == "quick":
        return {
            "discover_only": True,
            "port_scan": False,
            "service_detection": False,
            "os_detection": False,
            "script_scan": False,
            "udp_scan": False,
            "use_snmp": False,
            "fast_inventory": True,
            "mark_missing_inactive": False,
            "timing": 4,
            "top_ports": 0,
            "max_detail_hosts": 0,
            "max_inventory_hosts": 64,
        }
    if profile == "standard":
        return {
            "discover_only": False,
            "port_scan": True,
            "service_detection": True,
            "os_detection": True,
            "script_scan": False,
            "udp_scan": False,
            "timing": 4,
            "top_ports": settings.nmap_top_ports,
            "max_detail_hosts": settings.nmap_detail_max_hosts,
            "max_inventory_hosts": 256,
            "ping_verify": True,
            "inventory_full_subnet": True,
            "fast_inventory": None,
        }
    if profile == "deep":
        return {
            "discover_only": False,
            "port_scan": True,
            "service_detection": True,
            "os_detection": True,
            "script_scan": True,
            "udp_scan": False,
            "timing": 3,
            "top_ports": 1000,
            "max_detail_hosts": 128,
            "max_inventory_hosts": 256,
            "ping_verify": True,
            "inventory_full_subnet": True,
            "detail_batch_size": 8,
            "fast_inventory": False,
            "discover_timeout_seconds": 300,
            "detail_total_timeout_seconds": 1800,
        }
    if profile == "aggressive":
        return {
            "discover_only": False,
            "port_scan": True,
            "service_detection": True,
            "os_detection": True,
            "script_scan": True,
            "udp_scan": True,
            "timing": 4,
            "min_rate": 1000,
            "top_ports": 1000,
            "max_detail_hosts": 256,
            "max_inventory_hosts": 256,
            "ping_verify": True,
            "detail_batch_size": 12,
            "skip_suspicious_check": True,
            "fast_inventory": False,
            "discover_timeout_seconds": 300,
            "detail_total_timeout_seconds": 3600,
            "inventory_timeout_seconds": 1800,
        }
    return {}


def resolve_scan_options(
    options: ScanOptions | dict[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    snmp_community_fallback: str | None = None,
) -> ResolvedScanOptions:
    opts = options if isinstance(options, ScanOptions) else ScanOptions.from_dict(options)

"""Enriquecimento via SSH (Linux / network OS)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import logging
import re
import socket

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

SSH_PORT = 22

VENDOR_PATTERNS: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    (r"cisco ios", "Cisco"),
    (r"ios xe", "Cisco"),
    (r"juniper", "Juniper"),
    (r"mikrotik", "MikroTik"),
    (r"routeros", "MikroTik"),
    (r"fortinet", "Fortinet"),
    (r"fortigate", "Fortinet"),
    (r"palo alto", "Palo Alto"),
    (r"linux", "Linux"),
    (r"ubuntu", "Ubuntu"),
    (r"debian", "Debian"),
    (r"centos", "CentOS"),
    (r"windows", "Microsoft"),
)


@dataclass
class SshDeviceInfo:
    hostname: str | None = None
    os_name: str | None = None
    vendor: str | None = None
    model: str | None = None
    device_type: str | None = None
    reachable: bool = False
    port_open: bool = False
    error: str | None = None
    extra: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


def is_ssh_port_open(host: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> bool:
    timeout = timeout if timeout is not None else settings.ssh_timeout_seconds
    try:
        with socket.create_connection((host, SSH_PORT), timeout=min(timeout, 3.0)):
            return True
    except OSError:
        return False


def ssh_credentials_configured() -> bool:
    return bool(settings.ssh_enabled and settings.ssh_default_username and settings.ssh_default_password)


def _parse_output(text: str) -> SshDeviceInfo:
    info = SshDeviceInfo()
    lower = text.lower()
    for pattern, vendor in VENDOR_PATTERNS:
        if re.search(pattern, lower):
            info.vendor = vendor
            break

    if "fortigate" in lower or "fortinet" in lower:
        info.device_type = "firewall"
    elif any(w in lower for w in ("router", "routeros", "junos")):
        info.device_type = "router"
    elif any(w in lower for w in ("switch", "catalyst")):
        info.device_type = "switch"
    elif "linux" in lower or "gnu/linux" in lower:
        info.device_type = "server"

    hostname_match = re.search(r"hostname[:\s]+(\S+)", text, re.I)
    if hostname_match:
        info.hostname = hostname_match.group(1).strip()

    model_match = re.search(r"(?:Model|Hardware)[:\s]+(.+)", text, re.I)
    if model_match:
        info.model = model_match.group(1).strip()[:120]

    first_line = text.strip().split("\n", 1)[0][:200]
    if first_line:
        info.os_name = first_line

    return info


def collect_ssh_info(
    host: str,
    username: str | None = None,
    password: str | None = None,
    *,
    timeout: float | None = None,
) -> SshDeviceInfo:
    info = SshDeviceInfo()
    info.port_open = is_ssh_port_open(host, timeout)
    if not info.port_open:
        info.error = "porta SSH (22) fechada"
        return info

    username = username or settings.ssh_default_username
    password = password or settings.ssh_default_password
    if not username or not password:
        info.reachable = True
        info.error = "credenciais SSH não configuradas"
        return info

    timeout = timeout if timeout is not None else settings.ssh_timeout_seconds

    try:
        import paramiko
    except ImportError:
        info.error = "paramiko não instalado"
        return info

    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
    commands = (
        "show version",
        "uname -a; hostname 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -5",
    )
    try:
        client.connect(
            host,
            username=username,
            password=password,
            timeout=min(timeout, 10.0),
            look_for_keys=False,
            allow_agent=False,
        )
        output = ""
        for cmd in commands:
            _, stdout, _ = client.exec_command(cmd, timeout=min(timeout, 12.0))
            chunk = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
            if chunk:
                output = chunk
                break
        if output:
            parsed = _parse_output(output)
            info.hostname = parsed.hostname
            info.os_name = parsed.os_name
            info.vendor = parsed.vendor
            info.model = parsed.model
            info.device_type = parsed.device_type
            info.reachable = True
        else:
            info.error = "SSH conectou mas sem saída útil"
    except Exception as exc:
        info.error = str(exc)[:200]
        logger.debug("SSH discovery failed for %s: %s", host, exc)
    finally:
        client.close()

    return info
