    sub_status = "active"
    last_payment = None
    if sub:
        plan = session.get(BillingPlan, sub.plan_id)
        plan_slug = plan.slug if plan else "free"
        sub_status = sub.status
        last_payment = sub.current_period_start
    return {
        "stripe_enabled": settings.stripe_enabled,
        "publishable_key": settings.stripe_publishable_key or None,

def create_checkout_session(session: Session, org_id: int, plan_slug: str) -> dict:
    plan = session.execute(
        select(BillingPlan).where(BillingPlan.slug == plan_slug)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not plan:
        raise ValueError("Plano inválido")

    session_id = f"cs_{secrets.token_hex(12)}"
    if settings.stripe_enabled and settings.stripe_secret_key:
        mode = "stripe"
        checkout_url = f"https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/{session_id}"
    else:
        mode = "simulated"
        checkout_url = f"http://localhost:5173/platform?tab=autonomous&checkout={session_id}&plan={plan_slug}"

    sub = session.execute(
        select(OrgSubscription).where(OrgSubscription.org_id == org_id)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if sub and mode == "simulated":
        sub.plan_id = plan.id
        sub.status = "active"
        sub.current_period_start = datetime.now(UTC)
        from app.services.phase17_service import create_invoice
        create_invoice(session, org_id, plan_slug, plan.price_monthly)

    return {
        "checkout_url": checkout_url,
        "session_id": session_id,
        "mode": mode,
        "plan_slug": plan_slug,
    }


def analyze_topology_map(session: Session, map_layer: str, image_base64: str | None) -> dict:
    from app.services.topology_service import build_topology_graph

    graph = build_topology_graph(session, map_layer=map_layer or "physical")
    nodes = [n for n in graph.get("nodes", []) if not n.get("is_group")]
    offline = sum(1 for n in nodes if n.get("status") == "inactive")
    groups = sum(1 for n in graph.get("nodes", []) if n.get("is_group"))
    ctx = {
        "nodes": len(nodes),
        "edges": len(graph.get("edges", [])),
        "offline": offline,
        "groups": groups,
        "map_layer": map_layer,
    }

    source = "rules-engine"
    findings: list[str] = []
    if image_base64 and vision_available():
        llm_text = analyze_map_image(image_base64, ctx)
        if llm_text:
            source = settings.copilot_llm_provider
            return {"analysis": llm_text, "findings": [], "source": source}

    analysis, findings = rules_map_analysis(ctx)
    return {"analysis": analysis, "findings": findings, "source": source}


def get_cdn_status() -> dict:
    regions = [r.strip() for r in settings.agent_cdn_regions.split(",") if r.strip()]
    return {
        "enabled": settings.agent_cdn_enabled,
        "base_url": settings.agent_cdn_base_url or None,
        "regions": regions,
        "manifest_version": settings.agent_cdn_manifest_version,
    }


def get_cdn_manifest() -> dict:
    base = settings.agent_cdn_base_url.rstrip("/") if settings.agent_cdn_base_url else "https://cdn.sentinelai.io"
    regions = [r.strip() for r in settings.agent_cdn_regions.split(",") if r.strip()]
    endpoints = {reg: f"{base}/{reg}/agent/latest" for reg in regions}
    return {

        "agent_binary": "sentinelai-agent",
        "checksum_sha256": "demo-checksum-phase16",
        "endpoints": endpoints,
        "updated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    }

import secrets

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import AuditLog, Organization, PaymentInvoice, RemediationRun


def generate_invoice_number() -> str:
    return f"INV-{datetime.now(UTC).strftime('%Y%m%d')}-{secrets.token_hex(3).upper()}"


def create_invoice(session: Session, org_id: int, plan_slug: str, amount_cents: int) -> PaymentInvoice:
    inv = PaymentInvoice(
        org_id=org_id,
        plan_slug=plan_slug,
        amount_cents=amount_cents,
        currency="BRL",
        status="paid",
        invoice_number=generate_invoice_number(),
        stripe_session_id=None,
    )
    session.add(inv)
    session.flush()
    return inv


def list_invoices(session: Session, org_id: int | None = None, limit: int = 20) -> list[PaymentInvoice]:
    q = select(PaymentInvoice).order_by(PaymentInvoice.created_at.desc()).limit(limit)
    if org_id:
        q = q.where(PaymentInvoice.org_id == org_id)
    return list(session.execute(q).scalars().all())


def handle_stripe_webhook(session: Session, event_type: str, session_id: str, plan_slug: str, org_id: int | None) -> dict:
    from app.models import BillingPlan, OrgSubscription
    from app.services.phase15_service import ensure_org_subscription

    if event_type not in ("checkout.session.completed", "invoice.paid", "simulated.checkout"):
        return {"processed": False, "reason": f"event ignored: {event_type}"}

    if not org_id:
        org = session.execute(select(Organization).where(Organization.is_active.is_(True)).limit(1)).scalar_one_or_none()
        org_id = org.id if org else 1

    plan = session.execute(select(BillingPlan).where(BillingPlan.slug == plan_slug)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not plan:
        return {"processed": False, "reason": "plan not found"}

    sub = ensure_org_subscription(session, org_id)
    sub.plan_id = plan.id
    sub.status = "active"
    sub.current_period_start = datetime.now(UTC)
    sub.current_period_end = datetime.now(UTC) + timedelta(days=30)
    sub.stripe_customer_id = session_id[:80]

    inv = create_invoice(session, org_id, plan_slug, plan.price_monthly)
    inv.stripe_session_id = session_id
    return {
        "processed": True,
        "org_id": org_id,
        "plan_slug": plan_slug,
        "invoice_number": inv.invoice_number,
    }


def get_cdn_provider_status() -> dict:
    regions = [r.strip() for r in settings.agent_cdn_regions.split(",") if r.strip()]
    provider = settings.cdn_provider.lower()
    base = settings.agent_cdn_base_url.rstrip("/") if settings.agent_cdn_base_url else "https://cdn.sentinelai.io"
    if provider == "cloudfront":
        edge_domains = [f"{r}.{settings.cdn_distribution_id}.cloudfront.net" for r in regions]
    elif provider == "fastly":
        edge_domains = [f"{r}-sentinelai.global.ssl.fastly.net" for r in regions]
    else:
        edge_domains = [f"{base}/{r}" for r in regions]
    return {
        "provider": provider,
        "enabled": settings.agent_cdn_enabled,
        "distribution_id": settings.cdn_distribution_id or None,
        "edge_domains": edge_domains,
        "cache_ttl_seconds": settings.cdn_cache_ttl_seconds,
    }


def get_remediation_schedule_status(session: Session) -> dict:
    last = session.execute(
        select(RemediationRun)
        .where(RemediationRun.dry_run.is_(False))
        .order_by(RemediationRun.started_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    return {
        "enabled": settings.remediation_schedule_enabled,
        "interval_minutes": settings.remediation_schedule_minutes,
        "last_run_at": last.completed_at if last else None,
        "playbooks_scheduled": ["device-down-restart-monitor", "stale-alert-ack"],
    }


def get_auditor_portal_status(session: Session) -> dict:
    since = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=30)
    audit_count = session.execute(
        select(func.count(AuditLog.id)).where(AuditLog.created_at >= since)
    ).scalar() or 0
    failures = session.execute(
        select(func.count(AuditLog.id)).where(
            AuditLog.created_at >= since, AuditLog.outcome == "failure"
        )
    ).scalar() or 0
    score = max(0.0, min(100.0, 100.0 - (failures / max(audit_count, 1) * 100)))
    portal_url = None
    if settings.auditor_portal_enabled:
        portal_url = f"http://localhost:8000/api/auditor/summary?token={settings.auditor_portal_token[:8]}..."
    return {
        "enabled": settings.auditor_portal_enabled,
        "portal_url": portal_url,
        "read_only": True,
        "audit_events_30d": audit_count,
        "compliance_score": round(score, 1),
    }


def get_auditor_summary(session: Session, period_days: int = 90) -> dict:
    since = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=period_days)
    audit_total = session.execute(
        select(func.count(AuditLog.id)).where(AuditLog.created_at >= since)
    ).scalar() or 0
    failures = session.execute(

            AuditLog.created_at >= since, AuditLog.outcome == "failure"
        )
    ).scalar() or 0
    remediation = session.execute(
        select(func.count(RemediationRun.id)).where(RemediationRun.started_at >= since)
    ).scalar() or 0
    orgs = session.execute(select(func.count(Organization.id))).scalar() or 0
    controls_total = 6
    controls_met = controls_total - (1 if failures > audit_total * 0.05 else 0)
    return {
        "period_days": period_days,
        "total_audit_events": audit_total,
        "failed_events": failures,
        "remediation_runs": remediation,
        "organizations": orgs,
        "controls_met": controls_met,
        "controls_total": controls_total,
    }

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def send_invoice_email(session: Session, invoice_id: int) -> dict:
    from app.engines.reporting.invoice_pdf import generate_invoice_pdf

    invoice = session.get(PaymentInvoice, invoice_id)
    if not invoice:
        raise ValueError("Invoice não encontrada")

    pdf_path = generate_invoice_pdf(session, invoice)
    recipient = settings.alert_email_to or settings.smtp_from

    if settings.smtp_host and recipient:
        import asyncio

        import aiosmtplib

        async def _send() -> None:
            from email.message import EmailMessage

            msg = EmailMessage()
            msg["Subject"] = f"SentinelAI — Fatura {invoice.invoice_number}"
            msg["From"] = settings.smtp_from
            msg["To"] = recipient
            msg.set_content(
                f"Sua fatura SentinelAI ({invoice.plan_slug}) — R$ {invoice.amount_cents / 100:.2f}\n"
                f"Anexo: PDF da fatura."
            )
            with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
                msg.add_attachment(f.read(), maintype="application", subtype="pdf", filename=os.path.basename(pdf_path))
            await aiosmtplib.send(
                msg,
                hostname=settings.smtp_host,
                port=settings.smtp_port,
                username=settings.smtp_user or None,
                password=settings.smtp_password or None,
                start_tls=True,
            )

        try:
            asyncio.run(_send())
            channel = "smtp"
            sent = True
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("Invoice email failed: %s", exc)
            channel = "smtp_failed"
            sent = False
    else:
        channel = "simulated"
        sent = True
        logger.info("Invoice PDF ready (simulated email): %s -> %s", pdf_path, recipient or "no-recipient")

    return {
        "invoice_id": invoice_id,
        "sent": sent,
        "channel": channel,
        "recipient": recipient,
    }

    from app.models import ConfigBackup, Event, EventSeverity

    if not approval:
        raise ValueError("Aprovação não encontrada")
    if approval.status != "pending":
        raise ValueError("Aprovação já processada")

    approval.status = "approved" if approved else "rejected"
    approval.reviewed_by = reviewer.username
    approval.review_comment = comment or None
    approval.reviewed_at = datetime.now(UTC)

    run_result = None
    if approved:
        kind = getattr(approval, "kind", None) or "remediation"
        if kind == "config_restore":
            payload = approval.payload or {}
            device_id = payload.get("device_id")
            backup_id = payload.get("backup_id")
            backup = session.get(ConfigBackup, backup_id) if backup_id else None
            if not backup or (device_id and backup.device_id != device_id):
                raise ValueError("Backup de config inválido para restore")
            session.add(
                Event(
                    device_id=backup.device_id,
                    event_type="config_restore_approved",
                    message=(

                        f"(hash {backup.content_hash[:12]}…) por {reviewer.username}"

                    severity=EventSeverity.WARNING,
                )
            )
            run_result = {
                "kind": "config_restore",
                "device_id": backup.device_id,
                "backup_id": backup.id,
                "status": "queued_manual",
                "note": "Aprovado — execução SSH de restore pode ser acionada pelo operador",

        else:
            run = run_playbook(session, approval.playbook_slug, dry_run=False)
            run_result = {"id": run.id, "status": run.status, "actions": run.actions_taken or []}

    return {

        "status": approval.status,

        "run": run_result,
    }

"""Sincroniza inventário de plugins (Proxmox, VMware, AWS, Azure) para Device."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.engines.plugins.registry import run_plugin
from app.models import Device, DeviceStatus, Monitor, MonitorType, PluginInstance

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _upsert_vm_device(
    session: Session,
    *,
    ip_or_name: str,
    hostname: str,
    plugin_key: str,
    hypervisor: str,
    status: str = "active",
    extra: dict | None = None,
) -> tuple[Device, bool]:
    ip_key = f"{plugin_key}:{ip_or_name}"
    existing = session.execute(select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == ip_key)).scalar_one_or_none()
    extra_data = {
        "plugin_source": plugin_key,
        "hypervisor": hypervisor,
        "vm_name": hostname,
        **(extra or {}),
    }
    if existing:
        existing.hostname = hostname
        existing.device_type = "vm"
        existing.status = DeviceStatus.ACTIVE if status == "active" else DeviceStatus.INACTIVE
        existing.last_seen = datetime.now(UTC)
        merged = dict(existing.extra_data or {})
        merged.update(extra_data)
        existing.extra_data = merged
        session.add(existing)
        return existing, False

    device = Device(
        ip_address=ip_key,
        hostname=hostname,
        device_type="vm",
        status=DeviceStatus.ACTIVE if status == "active" else DeviceStatus.INACTIVE,
        vendor=plugin_key,
        extra_data=extra_data,
        last_seen=datetime.now(UTC),
    )
    session.add(device)
    session.flush()
    session.add(
        Monitor(
            device_id=device.id,
            monitor_type=MonitorType.PING,
            target=ip_key,
            is_enabled=True,
            interval_seconds=60,
        )
    )
    return device, True


def sync_proxmox_vms(session: Session, config: dict) -> dict:
    result = run_plugin("proxmox", config)
    if not result.success:
        return {"synced": 0, "error": result.message}

    host = config.get("host", "proxmox")
    items = (result.data or {}).get("vms") or []
    created = updated = 0
    for item in items:
        vmid = item.get("vmid")
        name = item.get("name") or f"vm-{vmid}"
        status = item.get("status") or "unknown"
        _, is_new = _upsert_vm_device(
            session,
            ip_or_name=str(vmid),
            hostname=name,
            plugin_key="proxmox",
            hypervisor=host,
            status=status,
            extra={"vmid": vmid, "node": item.get("node"), "status": status},
        )
        if is_new:
            created += 1
        else:
            updated += 1
    return {"synced": len(items), "created": created, "updated": updated}


def sync_plugin_instance(session: Session, plugin_id: int) -> dict:
    inst = session.get(PluginInstance, plugin_id)
    if not inst or not inst.is_enabled:
        return {"success": False, "message": "Plugin não encontrado ou desabilitado"}

    config = inst.config or {}
    if inst.plugin_key == "proxmox":
        sync_result = sync_proxmox_vms(session, config)
        inst.last_run_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        inst.last_status = "ok" if sync_result.get("synced", 0) >= 0 else "error"
        session.add(inst)
        return {"success": True, "message": f"Proxmox: {sync_result.get('synced', 0)} VMs", "data": sync_result}

    result = run_plugin(inst.plugin_key, config)
    vms = (result.data or {}).get("vms") or (result.data or {}).get("instances") or []
    if result.success and vms:
        host = config.get("host") or config.get("region") or inst.plugin_key
        created = updated = 0
        for item in vms:
            vmid = item.get("vmid") or item.get("name")
            name = item.get("name") or str(vmid)
            _, is_new = _upsert_vm_device(
                session,
                ip_or_name=str(vmid),
                hostname=name,
                plugin_key=inst.plugin_key,
                hypervisor=str(host),
                status=str(item.get("status") or "active"),
                extra=item,
            )
            if is_new:
                created += 1
            else:
                updated += 1
        inst.last_run_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        inst.last_status = "ok"
        session.add(inst)
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": f"{inst.plugin_key}: {len(vms)} VMs sincronizadas",
            "data": {"synced": len(vms), "created": created, "updated": updated},
        }

    inst.last_run_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    inst.last_status = "ok" if result.success else "error"
    session.add(inst)
    return {"success": result.success, "message": result.message, "data": result.data}


def sync_all_enabled_plugins(session: Session) -> dict:
    instances = session.execute(
        select(PluginInstance).where(PluginInstance.is_enabled.is_(True))
    ).scalars().all()
    results = []
    for inst in instances:
        try:
            results.append({"plugin_id": inst.id, "key": inst.plugin_key, **sync_plugin_instance(session, inst.id)})
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Plugin sync failed %s", inst.plugin_key)
            results.append({"plugin_id": inst.id, "key": inst.plugin_key, "success": False, "message": str(exc)})
    return {"plugins": results, "count": len(results)}

"""In-memory sliding-window rate limits (Fase 8.3)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import time
from collections import defaultdict, deque

from fastapi import HTTPException, Request, status

_lock = threading.Lock()
_buckets: dict[str, deque[float]] = defaultdict(deque)


def _client_ip(request: Request) -> str:
    forwarded = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for")
    if forwarded:
        return forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()
    if request.client:
        return request.client.host
    return "unknown"


def check_rate_limit(request: Request, *, key: str, limit: int, window_seconds: int) -> None:
    """Raise 429 if more than `limit` hits in the sliding window for ip+key."""
    now = time.monotonic()
    bucket_key = f"{key}:{_client_ip(request)}"
    with _lock:
        q = _buckets[bucket_key]
        while q and now - q[0] > window_seconds:
            q.popleft()
        if len(q) >= limit:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
                detail=f"Rate limit excedido ({limit}/{window_seconds}s). Tente novamente.",
            )
        q.append(now)

"""Site/client SLA aggregation for Phase 8."""

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Device, Site
from app.services.monitor_service import compute_device_sla


def compute_site_sla(session: Session, site_id: int, days: int = 30) -> dict:
    site = session.get(Site, site_id)
    if not site:
        raise ValueError("Site não encontrado")

    devices = session.execute(select(Device).where(Device.site_id == site_id).order_by(Device.ip_address)).scalars().all()
    contract = (site.default_credentials or {}).get("sla") if isinstance(site.default_credentials, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(contract, dict):
        contract = {}
    target = float(contract.get("target_pct") or 99.0)
    client_name = contract.get("client_name") or site.name

    device_rows: list[dict] = []
    uptimes: list[float] = []
    latencies: list[float] = []

    for device in devices:
        sla = compute_device_sla(session, device.id, days=days)
        uptime = sla.get("uptime_percent")
        avg_lat = sla.get("avg_latency_ms")
        if isinstance(uptime, (int, float)):
            uptimes.append(float(uptime))
        if isinstance(avg_lat, (int, float)):
            latencies.append(float(avg_lat))
        device_rows.append(
            {
                "device_id": device.id,
                "ip_address": device.ip_address,
                "hostname": device.hostname,
                "status": device.status.value if device.status else None,
                "uptime_percent": uptime,
                "avg_latency_ms": avg_lat,
                "samples": sla.get("samples", 0),
                "meets_target": (uptime is not None and float(uptime) >= target),
            }
        )

    site_uptime = round(sum(uptimes) / len(uptimes), 2) if uptimes else None
    site_latency = round(sum(latencies) / len(latencies), 2) if latencies else None
    breach = site_uptime is not None and site_uptime < target

    return {
        "site_id": site.id,
        "site_code": site.code,
        "site_name": site.name,
        "client_name": client_name,
        "region": site.region,
        "days": days,
        "sla_target_pct": target,
        "uptime_percent": site_uptime,
        "avg_latency_ms": site_latency,
        "device_count": len(devices),
        "devices_with_samples": len(uptimes),
        "breach": breach,
        "devices": device_rows,
    }

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import or_, select, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.engines.topology.neighbor_collector import NeighborInfo, collect_cdp_neighbors, collect_lldp_neighbors
from app.models import Device, DeviceStatus, LinkProtocol, LinkStatus, NetworkLink, TopologyGroup, TopologyLayout
from app.services.device_service import create_device_with_monitor_sync


def _resolve_device(session: Session, neighbor: NeighborInfo) -> Device | None:
    if neighbor.remote_ip:
        device = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == neighbor.remote_ip)
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if device and device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return device

    if neighbor.remote_name:
        device = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(
                or_(
                    Device.hostname == neighbor.remote_name,
                    Device.hostname.ilike(neighbor.remote_name),
                )
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if device and device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return device

        device = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(Device.hostname.ilike(f"%{neighbor.remote_name}%"))
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if device and device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return device
    return None


def register_neighbor_device(session: Session, neighbor: NeighborInfo) -> Device | None:
    if not neighbor.remote_ip:
        return None
    existing = session.execute(
        select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == neighbor.remote_ip)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing:
        if existing.status == DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return None
        return existing
    return create_device_with_monitor_sync(
        session,
        ip_address=neighbor.remote_ip,
        hostname=neighbor.remote_name,
        device_type="network_device",
    )


def _upsert_link(
    session: Session,
    source: Device,
    neighbor: NeighborInfo,
    target: Device | None,
    edge_style: str = "smoothstep",
    map_layer: str = "physical",
) -> bool:
    protocol = LinkProtocol(neighbor.protocol) if neighbor.protocol != "manual" else LinkProtocol.MANUAL
    existing = session.execute(
        select(NetworkLink).where(
            NetworkLink.source_device_id == source.id,
            NetworkLink.source_port == neighbor.local_port,
            NetworkLink.remote_hostname == neighbor.remote_name,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()

    if existing:
        existing.target_device_id = target.id if target else existing.target_device_id
        existing.target_port = neighbor.remote_port
        existing.remote_ip = neighbor.remote_ip
        existing.protocol = protocol
        existing.status = LinkStatus.ACTIVE
        existing.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        session.add(existing)
        return False

    session.add(
        NetworkLink(
            source_device_id=source.id,
            target_device_id=target.id if target else None,
            source_port=neighbor.local_port,
            target_port=neighbor.remote_port,
            remote_hostname=neighbor.remote_name,
            remote_ip=neighbor.remote_ip,
            protocol=protocol,
            status=LinkStatus.ACTIVE,
            edge_style=edge_style,
            map_layer=map_layer,
        )
    )
    return True


def discover_topology_for_device(session: Session, device: Device, community: str | None = None) -> int:
    neighbors = collect_lldp_neighbors(device.ip_address, community)
    if not neighbors:
        neighbors = collect_cdp_neighbors(device.ip_address, community)

    created = 0
    for neighbor in neighbors:
        registered = register_neighbor_device(session, neighbor)
        target = registered or _resolve_device(session, neighbor)
        if _upsert_link(session, device, neighbor, target):
            created += 1
    return created


def _normalize_handles(
    source_handle: str | None,
    target_handle: str | None,
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    valid_source = {"right", "bottom"}
    valid_target = {"top", "left"}
    sh = source_handle if source_handle in valid_source else "right"
    th = target_handle if target_handle in valid_target else "left"

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import secrets
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import WallboardShare


def _slugify(name: str) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", name.lower()).strip("-")
    return (s or "noc")[:60]


def list_wallboards(session: Session) -> list[WallboardShare]:
    return session.execute(select(WallboardShare).order_by(WallboardShare.created_at.desc())).scalars().all()


def create_wallboard(session: Session, data: dict) -> WallboardShare:
    slug = (data.get("slug") or _slugify(data["name"])).strip().lower()
    existing = session.execute(select(WallboardShare).where(WallboardShare.slug == slug)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing:
        raise ValueError(f"Slug '{slug}' já existe")
    row = WallboardShare(
        name=data["name"],
        slug=slug,
        token=secrets.token_urlsafe(24),
        panel_ids=list(data.get("panel_ids") or []),
        rotate_seconds=max(5, int(data.get("rotate_seconds") or 30)),
        high_contrast=bool(data.get("high_contrast", True)),
        is_active=True,
    )
    session.add(row)
    session.flush()
    return row


def delete_wallboard(session: Session, wallboard_id: int) -> bool:
    row = session.get(WallboardShare, wallboard_id)
    if not row:
        return False
    session.delete(row)
    session.flush()
    return True


def rotate_wallboard_token(session: Session, wallboard_id: int) -> WallboardShare | None:
    row = session.get(WallboardShare, wallboard_id)
    if not row:
        return None
    row.token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    session.add(row)
    session.flush()
    return row


def get_wallboard_by_slug(session: Session, slug: str) -> WallboardShare | None:
    return session.execute(
        select(WallboardShare).where(WallboardShare.slug == slug, WallboardShare.is_active.is_(True))
    ).scalar_one_or_none()


def public_wallboard_payload(session: Session, slug: str, token: str) -> dict | None:
    row = get_wallboard_by_slug(session, slug)
    if not row or row.token != token:
        return None

    from app.services.zion_panels import list_panels
    from app.services.zion_service import get_overview

    overview = get_overview(session)
    panels = list_panels(session, include_cards=True)
    wanted = set(row.panel_ids or [])
    if wanted:
        panels = [p for p in panels if p.get("id") in wanted]

    return {
        "name": row.name,
        "slug": row.slug,
        "rotate_seconds": row.rotate_seconds,
        "high_contrast": row.high_contrast,
        "overview": overview,
        "panels": panels,
        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC),
    }


def wallboard_response(row: WallboardShare, *, include_token: bool = False) -> dict:
    data = {
        "id": row.id,
        "slug": row.slug,
        "name": row.name,
        "panel_ids": list(row.panel_ids or []),
        "rotate_seconds": row.rotate_seconds,
        "high_contrast": row.high_contrast,
        "is_active": row.is_active,
        "created_at": row.created_at,
        "token": row.token if include_token else None,
        "public_url": f"#/wallboard/{row.slug}?token={row.token}" if include_token else f"#/wallboard/{row.slug}",
    }
    return data

    devices_found: int | None = None,

) -> None:
    session.expire(job)

        job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING
        job.started_at = datetime.now(UTC)

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import select

from app.config import settings
from app.db_sync import SyncSession
from app.engines.scanner.port_scanner import COMMON_PORTS, scan_ports
from app.models import Device, DeviceStatus, DiscoveryJobStatus, PortScanJob
from app.services.inventory_service import merge_extra_data, record_device_change_sync
from app.services.topology_service import (
    build_topology_graph,
    discover_topology_for_device,
    infer_gateway_links,
)
from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app


@celery_app.task(name="app.workers.topology_tasks.run_topology_discovery")
def run_topology_discovery() -> dict:
    with SyncSession() as session:
        devices = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(Device.status.in_([DeviceStatus.ACTIVE, DeviceStatus.UNKNOWN]))
        ).scalars().all()

        links_created = 0
        for device in devices:
            try:
                links_created += discover_topology_for_device(session, device, settings.snmp_community)
            except Exception:
                continue

        inferred = infer_gateway_links(session)
        session.commit()

    return {"links_created": links_created, "inferred": inferred}


@celery_app.task(name="app.workers.topology_tasks.run_port_scan")
def run_port_scan(job_id: int) -> dict:
    import asyncio

    with SyncSession() as session:
        job = session.get(PortScanJob, job_id)
        if not job:
            return {"error": "job not found"}

        device = session.get(Device, job.device_id)
        if not device:
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_message = "Dispositivo não encontrado"
            session.commit()
            return {"error": "device not found"}

        job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING
        job.started_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        job.ports_total = len(COMMON_PORTS)
        session.commit()

        try:
            open_ports = asyncio.run(scan_ports(device.ip_address))
            results = [
                {
                    "port": port.port,
                    "open": port.open,
                    "service": port.service,
                    "banner": port.banner,
                }
                for port in open_ports
            ]

            job.results = results
            job.ports_open = len(results)
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.COMPLETED
            job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)

            merged = merge_extra_data(device.extra_data, {"open_ports": results})
            if merged != (device.extra_data or {}):
                old_str = str(device.extra_data)
                device.extra_data = merged
                record_device_change_sync(session, device.id, "extra_data", old_str, str(merged))

            device.last_scan_at = datetime.now(UTC)
            session.add(device)
            session.commit()
            return {"job_id": job_id, "ports_open": job.ports_open}
        except Exception as exc:
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_message = str(exc)
            job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
            session.commit()
            raise

"""WebSocket vision analysis stream (Fase 18)."""

import asyncio
import logging

from fastapi import WebSocket

from app.config import settings
from app.db_sync import SyncSession
from app.engines.ai.vision_client import vision_available
from app.services.phase16_service import analyze_topology_map

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def stream_vision_analysis(websocket: WebSocket, map_layer: str = "physical") -> None:
    await websocket.accept()
    await websocket.send_json({"type": "started", "model": settings.map_vision_model})

    with SyncSession() as session:
        result = analyze_topology_map(session, map_layer, None)

    chunks = result["analysis"].split(". ")
    for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
        if not chunk.strip():
            continue
        await websocket.send_json({
            "type": "chunk",
            "index": i,
            "text": chunk.strip() + ("" if chunk.endswith(".") else "."),
            "source": result["source"],
        })
        await asyncio.sleep(0.15)

    await websocket.send_json({
        "type": "complete",
        "source": result["source"],
        "findings": result.get("findings", []),
        "vision_available": vision_available(),
    })

"""Teste rápido: add no mapa, graph, retire — devices aposentados não voltam."""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys

from sqlalchemy import select

from app.db_sync import SyncSession
from app.models import Device, DeviceStatus, TopologyLayout
from app.services.device_service import create_device_with_monitor_sync
from app.services.topology_service import build_topology_graph


def run() -> int:
    test_ip = "192.168.99.77"
    errors: list[str] = []

    with SyncSession() as session:
        existing = session.execute(select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == test_ip)).scalar_one_or_none()
        if existing:
            layout = session.get(TopologyLayout, existing.id)
            if layout:
                session.delete(layout)
            session.delete(existing)
            session.commit()

        device = create_device_with_monitor_sync(
            session,
            ip_address=test_ip,
            device_type="router",
        )
        session.add(
            TopologyLayout(
                device_id=device.id,
                pos_x=120.0,
                pos_y=80.0,
                map_layer="physical",
            )
        )
        session.commit()
        device_id = device.id

        graph = build_topology_graph(session, map_layer="physical")
        ids = {n["device_id"] for n in graph["nodes"] if n.get("device_id")}
        if device_id not in ids:
            errors.append("device com layout deveria aparecer no graph")

        device = session.get(Device, device_id)
        device.status = DeviceStatus.RETIRED
        layout = session.get(TopologyLayout, device_id)
        if layout:
            session.delete(layout)
        session.commit()

        graph2 = build_topology_graph(session, map_layer="physical")
        ids2 = {n["device_id"] for n in graph2["nodes"] if n.get("device_id")}
        if device_id in ids2:
            errors.append("device aposentado NÃO deveria aparecer no graph")

        device = session.get(Device, device_id)
        if device:
            session.delete(device)
            session.commit()

    if errors:
        for e in errors:
            print("FAIL:", e)
        return 1

    print("OK: add layout -> graph | retire -> sumiu do graph")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(run())

"""Testes Fase 6 — wallboard token + schemas OID."""

from __future__ import annotations


def test_wallboard_public_requires_token(client):
    resp = client.get("/api/wallboard/public/demo-noc")
    assert resp.status_code in (401, 422)


def test_wallboard_crud_and_public(client, auth_headers):
    create = client.post(
        "/api/wallboard",
        headers=auth_headers,
        json={"name": "NOC TV Lab", "slug": "noc-tv-lab", "rotate_seconds": 15, "high_contrast": True},
    )
    if create.status_code == 400 and "já existe" in create.text:
        # limpa e tenta de novo em reexecução
        listed = client.get("/api/wallboard", headers=auth_headers)
        assert listed.status_code == 200
        for row in listed.json():
            if row.get("slug") == "noc-tv-lab":
                client.delete(f"/api/wallboard/{row['id']}", headers=auth_headers)
        create = client.post(
            "/api/wallboard",
            headers=auth_headers,
            json={"name": "NOC TV Lab", "slug": "noc-tv-lab", "rotate_seconds": 15},
        )

    assert create.status_code == 201, create.text
    body = create.json()
    assert body["slug"] == "noc-tv-lab"
    assert body.get("token")
    token = body["token"]

    bad = client.get(f"/api/wallboard/public/noc-tv-lab?token=wrong")
    assert bad.status_code == 401

    ok = client.get(f"/api/wallboard/public/noc-tv-lab?token={token}")
    assert ok.status_code == 200, ok.text
    payload = ok.json()
    assert payload["name"] == "NOC TV Lab"
    assert "overview" in payload
    assert "panels" in payload
    assert payload["rotate_seconds"] == 15

    deleted = client.delete(f"/api/wallboard/{body['id']}", headers=auth_headers)
    assert deleted.status_code == 200

# SentinelAI Helm Chart

```bash
helm install sentinelai ./deploy/helm/sentinelai \
  --set postgresql.auth.password=CHANGE_ME \
  --set ingress.enabled=true
```

## GitOps (Argo CD)

Aponte o Application para este chart ou use o repositório com Kustomize overlay.

## Valores principais

| Valor | Descrição |
|-------|-----------|
| `replicaCount` | Réplicas da API |
| `config.prometheusEnabled` | Métricas Prometheus |
| `config.haMode` | Modo HA |
| `ingress.enabled` | Expor via Ingress |

#!/bin/sh
set -e
DATA="/var/lib/postgresql/data"

if [ ! -s "$DATA/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "Aguardando primary..."
  until pg_isready -h postgres -p 5432 -U "$POSTGRES_USER"; do sleep 2; done
  rm -rf "$DATA"/*
  pg_basebackup -h postgres -D "$DATA" -U replicator -Fp -Xs -P -R
  echo "Replica inicializada via pg_basebackup"
fi

exec docker-entrypoint.sh postgres

nodes.code:
# Agent lab SentinelAI (Fase 7.1)

Script leve Win/Linux que envia heartbeat + métricas (CPU/RAM/disco/serviços) para a API.

## Pré-requisitos

1. Backend SentinelAI rodando.
2. Em **Infraestrutura → Agentes**, criar um agent e copiar o **token** (mostrado uma vez).
3. (Recomendado) Associar `device_id` ao agent (PATCH ou ao criar) para gravar métricas em `metrics` do device.

```bash
# criar via API (exemplo)
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/agents \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"lab-01","device_id":1,"assigned_subnets":[]}'
```

## Rodar 1 agent

```powershell
$env:SENTINEL_URL="http://localhost:8000"
$env:SENTINEL_AGENT_TOKEN="<token>"
$env:SENTINEL_INTERVAL="30"
python agent/sentinel_lab_agent.py
```

Opcional: `pip install psutil` para métricas reais (sem psutil o script usa fallback de lab).

## Critério lab (5 agents)

Crie 5 agents na UI/API, rode 5 processos (ou 5 terminais) com tokens distintos. Em **Infraestrutura → Agentes** devem aparecer `online` com `last_metrics` preenchido.

Endpoints:

- `POST /api/agents/heartbeat` — Authorization: Bearer `<agent-token>`
- `POST /api/agents/metrics` — body `{ cpu_pct, mem_pct, disk_pct, hostname, services[] }`

```powershell
.\scripts\schedule-backup.ps1
```

nodes.title: CRONOGRAMA-ESTABILIZACAO.md
nodes.code:
# Cronograma SentinelAI — Estabilização, Melhorias e Novos Módulos

> Base: diagnóstico de 2026-07-23.  
> Objetivo: sair de “NMS com superfície rica” para **operação confiável** (tempo real, SNMP, alertas, segurança) e só então expandir módulos.

**Duração sugerida:** ~16 semanas (4 meses), 1 time pequeno (1–2 devs full-stack).  
**Regra de ouro:** não começar módulo novo enquanto P0/P1 da Fase 1–2 não estiverem fechados.

---

## Visão geral

| Fase | Semanas | Foco | Resultado esperado |
|------|---------|------|--------------------|
| **0** | 0 (kickoff) | Baseline e inventário honesto | Snapshot medível do estado atual |
| **1** | 1–2 | Correções P0 (SSE, reload, health, auth) | ✅ Concluída 2026-07-27 |
| **2** | 3–4 | Dados e alertas P1 (SNMP, canais UI) | ✅ Concluída 2026-07-27 |
| **3** | 5–6 | UX Zion + templates + empty states | ✅ Concluída 2026-07-28 |
| **4** | 7–8 | Credenciais por host + SNMPv3 + Vault | ✅ Concluída 2026-07-28 |
| **5** | 9–10 | Qualidade (Alembic, testes, CI, LLM) | ✅ Concluída 2026-07-28 |
| **6** | 11–12 | Módulos: sensores/OIDs + wallboard NOC | ✅ Concluída 2026-07-28 |
| **7** | 13–14 | Agent + CMDB/mudanças | Cobertura onde SNMP falha |
| **8** | 15–16 | SLA/contratos + playbooks visuais | Pronto para MSP / sala NOC |

---

## Fase 0 — Kickoff (1–2 dias) ✅ CONCLUÍDA 2026-07-23

**Objetivo:** medir antes de mudar.

| # | Tarefa | Entrega |
|---|--------|---------|
| 0.1 | Inventário real vs `docs/feature-inventory.json` | ✅ Lista parcial/missing em `stabilization` + notes NMS |
| 0.2 | Métricas baseline | ✅ SNMP **8/603**, ping **603/603**, CPU/RAM/disk **3**, temp **1** |
| 0.3 | Congelar escopo Fase 1–2 | ✅ Checklist em `docs/PHASE-0-BASELINE.md` |
| 0.4 | Backup Postgres + `.env` | ✅ `scripts/backup-sentinel.ps1` |

**Snapshot completo:** [`docs/PHASE-0-BASELINE.md`](PHASE-0-BASELINE.md)

**Critério de saída:** ✅ números baseline salvos (SNMP 8/603, ping 603).

---

## Fase 1 — Correções P0 (Semanas 1–2) ✅ CONCLUÍDA (2026-07-27)

**Objetivo:** plataforma não trava e tempo real funciona entre API ↔ workers.

| Semana | # | Item | Detalhe | Esforço |
|--------|---|------|---------|---------|
| 1 | 1.1 | **API prod sem `--reload`** | Compose default estável; `docker-compose.dev.yml` com reload | Baixo |
| 1 | 1.2 | **Health real** | `/health` checa Postgres + Redis + Celery; 503 se critical | Baixo |
| 1 | 1.3 | **Hardening auth** | `must_change_password` + `APP_ENV` bloqueia secrets fracos | Baixo–médio |
| 2 | 1.4 | **SSE via Redis pub/sub** | `realtime_events` canal Redis + history | Médio |
| 2 | 1.5 | **Token SSE seguro** | `POST /api/stream/ticket` (60s) + query `ticket` | Médio |
| 2 | 1.6 | **Graceful shutdown** | SSE max 300s + `--timeout-graceful-shutdown 8` | Baixo |

**Critério de saída:**
- [x] `docker compose ps` API healthy com DB/Redis verificados  
- [x] Evento do worker chega via Redis ao frontend (sem refresh)  
- [x] Login estável sem `--reload` no default  
- [x] Secrets default bloqueados quando `APP_ENV=production`  

**Próxima:** Fase 5 (Alembic, pytest, CI, IA segura).

---

## Fase 2 — Dados e alertas P1 (Semanas 3–4) ✅ CONCLUÍDA (2026-07-27)

**Objetivo:** indicadores Zion e alertas operacionais de verdade.

| Semana | # | Item | Detalhe | Esforço |
|--------|---|------|---------|---------|
| 3 | 2.1 | **Campanha SNMP** | Multi-community, retry, relatório “hosts sem SNMP” | Médio |
| 3 | 2.2 | **Dashboard cobertura** | Card: `% com SNMP / WMI / métricas` no Zion | Baixo |
| 3 | 2.3 | **Poll SNMP prioritário** | Fila: hosts críticos / com community conhecida primeiro | Médio |
| 4 | 2.4 | **UI canais de alerta** | CRUD SMTP, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Teams, Webhook, SMS (Twilio) por org | Médio |
| 4 | 2.5 | **Teste de canal** | Botão “Enviar teste” por canal | Baixo |
| 4 | 2.6 | **Destinatários por regra** | Ligar `alert_rules` → canais/destinos | Médio |

**Critério de saída:**
- [x] Campanha SNMP multi-community + relatório de hosts sem SNMP  
- [x] Dashboard cobertura SNMP/WMI/métricas no Zion  
- [x] Poll SNMP prioritário (hosts críticos / sem dados primeiro)  
- [x] Canais configuráveis na UI Alertas (não só `.env`)  
- [x] Botão “Enviar teste” por canal  
- [x] `alert_rules` ligadas a configs/destinatários  

**Próxima:** Fase 5 (Alembic, pytest, CI, IA segura).

# LLM — DeepSeek / Ollama / OpenAI

Configuração do NOC Copilot e do Chatbot (API OpenAI-compatible).

## Variáveis (`.env`)

| Variável | Exemplo | Nota |
|----------|---------|------|
| `COPILOT_LLM_ENABLED` | `true` | Liga chamadas externas |
| `COPILOT_LLM_PROVIDER` | `deepseek` / `ollama` / `openai` | Preset de URL/modelo |
| `COPILOT_LLM_API_KEY` | `sk-…` | Obrigatório exceto Ollama |
| `COPILOT_LLM_BASE_URL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | Ollama: `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` |
| `COPILOT_LLM_MODEL` | `deepseek-chat` | Ollama: `deepseek-r1:latest` |
| `COPILOT_LLM_MAX_TOKENS` | `1200` | Limite de resposta |
| `COPILOT_LLM_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | `30` | Rate limit local (Fase 5) |
| `COPILOT_LLM_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` | `5` | segundos |
| `COPILOT_LLM_READ_TIMEOUT` | `60` | segundos |

## DeepSeek (cloud)

1. Crie chave em [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com/)
2. `.env`:
   ```env
   COPILOT_LLM_ENABLED=true
   COPILOT_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek
   COPILOT_LLM_API_KEY=sk-...
   COPILOT_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-chat
   ```
3. Reinicie `api` / `worker`

Referência open-source: https://github.com/deepseek-ai

## Ollama (local)

```bash
ollama pull deepseek-r1
```

```env
COPILOT_LLM_ENABLED=true
COPILOT_LLM_PROVIDER=ollama
COPILOT_LLM_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1
COPILOT_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-r1:latest
```

No Docker Desktop, `host.docker.internal` aponta para o host onde o Ollama escuta.

## Segurança

- O chatbot **não** deve revelar senhas de demo ou secrets.
- Credenciais de coleta SNMP/WMI/SSH ficam em `/api/collect-auth` (criptografadas).
- Rate limit e timeouts evitam travar workers/API sob pico.

## Alembic (schema)

```bash
cd backend
alembic upgrade head          # DB vazia
alembic stamp head           # DB já criada por create_all
```

Opcional no boot: `RUN_ALEMBIC_ON_START=true`.

```powershell
# Na raiz do repo

```

- `sentinelai-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.sql.gz` — dump Postgres
- `env-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.backup` — cópia do `.env` (fora do git)

**Restore (resumo):**

```powershell
# Parar writers se necessário; depois:
docker compose exec -T postgres pg_restore ...  # ou psql < dump
# Preferir: gunzip -c backups\....sql.gz | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U sentinel -d sentinelai
```

Ver script para flags exatas. **Não commitar** a pasta `backups/` (já deve estar no `.gitignore`).

nodes.code:
# Como ligar o Zion em 5 passos

Guia do operador — do inventário vazio ao painel com CPU/RAM/disco.

## 1. Descobrir a rede

1. Abra **Zion → Descoberta**.
2. Informe a sub-rede (ex.: `192.168.1.0/24`).
3. Preencha as **communities SNMP** (ex.: `public,private`).
4. Clique em **Iniciar scan**.

Os hosts entram no inventário com ping. SNMP só funciona se a community estiver correta no equipamento.

## 2. Aplicar um template

1. Abra **Zion → Templates**.
2. Clique na linha do perfil (Windows Server, Linux, Cisco…).
3. No wizard, filtre por IP/hostname **ou** selecione hosts na lista.
4. **Pré-visualizar monitores** → confira o que será criado.
5. **Aplicar** — cria ping/SNMP (e itens CPU/RAM/disco quando o OID existir).

Atalho: **Auto-aplicar templates** tenta casar cada host pelo SO/vendor.

## 3. Rodar poll (preencher os “—” )

Cards com **—** mostram o motivo (sem SNMP, community errada, OID ausente).

- No card: **Rode poll** (coleta SNMP/WMI na hora).
- Ou **Configurar SNMP** (volta à Descoberta para community + scan).

Após o poll, CPU/memória/disco aparecem se o agente expõe HOST-RESOURCES-MIB (ou WMI no Windows).

## 4. Montar o painel

1. Em **Zion → Dashboard**, use **Criar painel de monitoramento**.
2. Escolha a métrica (temperatura, CPU, RAM, disco…).
3. Filtro útil: **Só com métricas (SNMP/WMI)** — evita cards vazios.
4. Ou cole IPs específicos e escolha o tipo (servidor/desktop/VM…).

Marque **Só com métricas (ocultar cards “—”)** para ver só hosts já instrumentados.

## 5. Conferir inventário e cobertura

1. **Inventário** → ative **Só com métricas** para listar quem já entrega dados.
2. No Dashboard, os cards de cobertura SNMP/WMI mostram o percentual da frota.
3. Hosts “Sem SNMP” → volte ao passo 1 (community) ou 2 (template + poll).

---

**Checklist rápido**

- [ ] Scan com community correta  
- [ ] Template aplicado nos hosts críticos  
- [ ] Poll sem erro de community/timeout  
- [ ] Painel com filtro “só com métricas”  
- [ ] Zero cards “—” sem explicação (hint + botão de ação)  

Documentação relacionada: `docs/CRONOGRAMA-ESTABILIZACAO.md` (Fase 3), `docs/PHASE-0-BASELINE.md`.

# SentinelAI Mobile (Expo)

App React Native nativo — Fase 12.

## Requisitos

- Node.js 20+
- Expo Go no celular (ou emulador Android/iOS)

## Executar

```bash
cd mobile
npm install
npx expo start
```

## Configurar API

Edite `app.json` → `extra.apiUrl`:

```json
"extra": {
  "apiUrl": "http://SEU_IP:8000"
}
```

No emulador Android use `http://10.0.2.2:8000`.

## App Store / Play Store (EAS)

```bash
npm install -g eas-cli
eas login
eas build --platform all --profile production
eas submit --platform all
```

Configure `eas.json` com Apple ID e Google Play service account.

## Assinatura do registry

O backend verifica checksum SHA256 + HMAC quando `MARKETPLACE_REGISTRY_SECRET` está definido.

param(
    [string]$OutDir = "",
    [string]$ComposeFile = "docker-compose.yml",
    [string]$PostgresService = "postgres",
    [string]$PostgresUser = "sentinel",
    [string]$PostgresDb = "sentinelai"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $OutDir) {
    $OutDir = Join-Path $Root "backups"
}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutDir | Out-Null

$Stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"
$SqlPath = Join-Path $OutDir ("sentinelai-{0}.sql" -f $Stamp)
$EnvSrc = Join-Path $Root ".env"
$EnvDst = Join-Path $OutDir ("env-{0}.backup" -f $Stamp)

Set-Location $Root

Write-Host "==> Dump Postgres..."
docker compose -f $ComposeFile exec -T $PostgresService pg_dump -U $PostgresUser -d $PostgresDb --no-owner --no-acl | Set-Content -Path $SqlPath -Encoding utf8

if (-not (Test-Path $SqlPath) -or (Get-Item $SqlPath).Length -lt 100) {
    throw ("Dump falhou ou ficou vazio: {0}" -f $SqlPath)
}

Write-Host "==> Compactando..."
$FinalSql = $SqlPath
$ZipPath = Join-Path $OutDir ("sentinelai-{0}.zip" -f $Stamp)
Compress-Archive -Path $SqlPath -DestinationPath $ZipPath -Force
Remove-Item $SqlPath -Force
$FinalSql = $ZipPath

if (Test-Path $EnvSrc) {
    Copy-Item $EnvSrc $EnvDst -Force
    Write-Host ("==> .env copiado para {0}" -f $EnvDst)
} else {
    Write-Warning (".env nao encontrado em {0}" -f $EnvSrc)
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Backup OK"
Write-Host ("  DB : {0}" -f $FinalSql)
if (Test-Path $EnvDst) {
    Write-Host ("  ENV: {0}" -f $EnvDst)
}
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Restore:"

Write-Host "  2) Get-Content arquivo.sql -Raw | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U sentinel -d sentinelai"

nodes.code:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inventário completo SentinelAI — veja tudo e escolha o que implementar.

COMANDO PRINCIPAL (mostra tudo + backlog para implementar):
  python scripts/feature-inventory.py all

Outros:
  python scripts/feature-inventory.py              # igual a "all"
  python scripts/feature-inventory.py map            # só Map Editor
  python scripts/feature-inventory.py nms            # só NMS
  python scripts/feature-inventory.py gaps           # só parciais/ausentes
  python scripts/feature-inventory.py backlog        # fila de implementação (com IDs)
  python scripts/feature-inventory.py --json
  python scripts/feature-inventory.py --prompt

PowerShell:
  .\\scripts\\feature-inventory.ps1
  .\\scripts\\feature-inventory.ps1 all

Para pedir implementação no Cursor, copie IDs do backlog, ex.:
  Implemente: nms.discovery_wmi, nms.sw_inventory, map.undo_redo
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA_FILE = ROOT / "docs" / "feature-inventory.json"

STATUS_ICON = {"done": "✅", "partial": "⚠️", "missing": "❌"}
STATUS_ORDER = {"missing": 0, "partial": 1, "done": 2}


def _configure_stdout() -> None:
    if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
        try:
            sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception:
            pass


def load_inventory() -> dict:
    if not DATA_FILE.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"Arquivo não encontrado: {DATA_FILE}")
    return json.loads(DATA_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def iter_items(data: dict, section: str | None = None) -> list[tuple[str, str, dict]]:
    sections = data["sections"]
    if section:
        if section not in sections:
            raise SystemExit(f"Seção inválida: {section!r}. Use: {', '.join(sections)}")
        sections = {section: sections[section]}
    rows: list[tuple[str, str, dict]] = []
    for key, block in sections.items():
        for item in block["items"]:
            rows.append((key, block["title"], item))
    return rows


def item_ref(section_key: str, item: dict) -> str:
    return f"{section_key}.{item['id']}"


def print_section_report(rows: list[tuple[str, str, dict]], *, gaps_only: bool) -> dict[str, int]:
    counts = {"done": 0, "partial": 0, "missing": 0}
    current: str | None = None

    for sec_key, sec_title, item in rows:
        if gaps_only and item["status"] == "done":
            continue
        counts[item["status"]] = counts.get(item["status"], 0) + 1
        if sec_key != current:
            current = sec_key
            print(f"\n## {sec_title}\n")
        icon = STATUS_ICON.get(item["status"], "?")
        ref = item_ref(sec_key, item)
        print(f"  {icon} [{ref}]")
        print(f"     {item['label']}")
        if item.get("notes"):
            print(f"     → {item['notes']}")
    return counts


def print_backlog(data: dict, section: str | None = None) -> None:
    rows = [
        (sk, st, it)
        for sk, st, it in iter_items(data, section)
        if it["status"] in ("partial", "missing")
    ]
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (STATUS_ORDER[r[2]["status"]], r[0], r[2]["id"]))

    print("\n" + "=" * 72)
    print("FILA DE IMPLEMENTAÇÃO (copie os IDs para pedir no Cursor)")
    print("=" * 72 + "\n")

    if not rows:
        print("  Nada pendente — inventário 100% completo.\n")
        return

    ids: list[str] = []
    for n, (sec_key, sec_title, item) in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        ref = item_ref(sec_key, item)
        ids.append(ref)
        icon = STATUS_ICON[item["status"]]
        print(f"  {n:2}. {icon} {ref}")
        print(f"      {item['label']}")
        if item.get("notes"):
            print(f"      → {item['notes']}")
        print()

    print("-" * 72)
    print("Prompt sugerido para o Cursor:\n")
    print(f"  Implemente no SentinelAI: {', '.join(ids)}\n")


def print_all(data: dict) -> None:
    rows = iter_items(data)
    print(f"SentinelAI — INVENTÁRIO COMPLETO (v{data['version']})")
    print("=" * 72)
    print("\n### STATUS GERAL\n")
    counts = print_section_report(rows, gaps_only=False)

    total = sum(counts.values())
    print("\n" + "-" * 72)
    print(
        f"Total: {total}  |  ✅ {counts.get('done', 0)}  |  "
        f"⚠️ {counts.get('partial', 0)}  |  ❌ {counts.get('missing', 0)}"
    )
    print(f"\nFonte: {DATA_FILE.relative_to(ROOT)}")

    print_backlog(data)

    print("=" * 72)
    print("PRÓXIMO PASSO")
    print("=" * 72)
    print("  1. Escolha IDs da fila acima")
    print("  2. No Cursor: Implemente no SentinelAI: <id1>, <id2>, ...")
    print("  3. Após implementar, atualize docs/feature-inventory.json\n")


def print_prompt(data: dict) -> None:
    backlog = [
        (sk, st, it)
        for sk, st, it in iter_items(data)
        if it["status"] in ("partial", "missing")
    ]
    backlog.sort(key=lambda r: (STATUS_ORDER[r[2]["status"]], r[0], r[2]["id"]))

    lines = [
        "Consulte docs/feature-inventory.json e valide no código.",
        "Mostre o inventário completo e a fila de implementação.",
        "",
        "Itens pendentes:",
    ]
    for sec_key, sec_title, item in backlog:
        ref = item_ref(sec_key, item)
        icon = STATUS_ICON[item["status"]]
        lines.append(f"- {icon} `{ref}` — {item['label']} ({item.get('notes', '')})")

param(
    [string]$Time = "02:30",
    [string]$TaskName = "SentinelAI-Backup",
    [string]$OutDir = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$BackupScript = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "backup-sentinel.ps1"
if (-not (Test-Path $BackupScript)) {
    throw "backup-sentinel.ps1 não encontrado"
}

$arg = "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$BackupScript`""
if ($OutDir) {
    $arg += " -OutDir `"$OutDir`""
}

$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute "powershell.exe" -Argument $arg -WorkingDirectory $Root
$trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At $Time
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -StartWhenAvailable -AllowStartIfOnBatteries

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate signed marketplace registry manifest."""

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PLUGINS_FILE = ROOT / "backend" / "app" / "data" / "marketplace-registry.json"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "backend" / "app" / "data" / "marketplace-registry.signed.json"
DEFAULT_SECRET = "sentinelai-registry-dev-secret"


def main() -> None:
    secret = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else DEFAULT_SECRET
    plugins = json.loads(PLUGINS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    payload = json.dumps(plugins, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    checksum = hashlib.sha256(payload.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), checksum.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    manifest = {"plugins": plugins, "checksum": checksum, "signature": signature}
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Written {OUTPUT}")
    print(f"checksum={checksum}")
    print(f"signature={signature[:16]}...")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
